00407d926e29.en: “Going to the duel?” A gray-haired man with blue hair strands at one side asked with a rather uncaring monotone, holding the contract Harry signed not long ago—at least based on Harry’s feeling of how much time has passed.
00407d926e29.t: “Nak pergi pertarungan?” Seorang lelaki berambut kelabu dengan helaian rambut biru di sebelah bertanya dengan nada mendatar yang agak tidak peduli, memegang kontrak yang Harry tandatangani tidak lama dahulu—sekurang-kurangnya berdasarkan perasaan Harry tentang berapa lama masa yang telah berlalu.

02a9b75b5678.en: “Yes! Finally!—who are you?” The anger in the girl’s voice disappeared, leaving behind a certain elegance, and charm.
02a9b75b5678.t: “Ya! Akhirnya!—kau ni siapa?” Kemarahan dalam suara gadis itu hilang, meninggalkan keanggunan dan pesona tertentu.

04a280ff24f9.en: My nose! Waa! I can’t breathe! Her anger pushed Harry’s head so far into the pillow that it felt like it was about to break inwards and pierce his skull—I can’t breathe! It hurts! Harry began losing his breath, and his groans turned into muffled screams, “EIRI! HELP!” He used his last breath to call for her, but nothing happened. His entire body felt chilled, as if he had just taken a cold shower. His heart was throttling back, apparently betraying his own racing mind. With his arms and legs growing completely numb, and forcibly relaxing too, he tried to flay them around with one last hurrah, but they also betrayed him. Most of his body, at least where he thought they would be, was now replaced with a waning tingle mixed with numbness. Like a dying fish, Harry was growing less agitated, but if you looked closely into its eye, you could still see the looming doom.
04a280ff24f9.t: Hidung aku! Waa! Aku tak boleh bernafas! Kemarahannya menolak kepala Harry begitu jauh ke dalam bantal sehingga terasa seolah-olah ia hendak pecah ke dalam dan menembusi tengkoraknya—Aku tak boleh bernafas! Sakit! Harry mula kehabisan nafas, dan erangannya bertukar menjadi jeritan yang teredam, “EIRI! TOLONG!” Dia menggunakan nafas terakhirnya untuk memanggilnya, tetapi tiada apa-apa yang berlaku. Seluruh tubuhnya terasa dingin, seolah-olah dia baru mandi air sejuk. Jantungnya semakin perlahan, nampaknya mengkhianati fikirannya sendiri yang berlumba. Dengan lengan dan kakinya menjadi kebas sepenuhnya, dan terpaksa mengendur juga, dia cuba melibas-libasnya dengan satu percubaan terakhir, tetapi ia juga mengkhianatinya. Kebanyakan tubuhnya, sekurang-kurangnya di mana dia fikir ia sepatutnya berada, kini digantikan dengan rasa kesemutan yang semakin pudar bercampur kebas. Seperti ikan yang nazak, Harry semakin kurang meronta, tetapi jika kau melihat dengan teliti ke dalam matanya, kau masih dapat melihat malapetaka yang menghampiri.

0588a89d8de2.en: Hmm. He looks pissed, so maybe I should keep it shut. Walking out into the courtyard, Harry felt the true shine of the sun, ticklishly warming his skin, and invading his eyes. He looked at the sky, and saw a beautiful summer day with barely any clouds around. Soothing the warmness of the sun, a weak gust of brisk wind passed by, playing with the green grass, and flowers.
0588a89d8de2.t: Hmm. Dia nampak marah, jadi mungkin aku patut diam. Berjalan keluar ke halaman, Harry merasakan sinar matahari yang sebenar, menghangatkan kulitnya dengan geli, dan menceroboh matanya. Dia memandang langit, dan nampak hari musim panas yang indah dengan hampir tiada awan di sekeliling. Menenangkan kehangatan matahari, tiupan angin segar yang lemah berlalu, bermain dengan rumput hijau dan bunga-bunga.

05ef73da6d48.en: Harry, lost in the conversation between these strangers, noticed a glint of light coming from where the Sanbi royals stood. Looking back, he saw Kibe energizing a spell. The white rings around his hands had two red balls of DNA strands circling about, right before he released it on Neferteri’s hands. The spell took a quick effect on her, swelling up her chin and neck, like she had developed goiter out of the blue.
05ef73da6d48.t: Harry, hilang dalam perbualan antara orang-orang asing ini, perasan kilauan cahaya datang dari tempat Sanbi royal berdiri. Menoleh, dia nampak Kibe sedang menghidupkan jampi. Gelang putih di sekeliling tangannya mempunyai dua bola merah helaian DNA yang berpusing, sebelum dia melepaskannya ke tangan Neferteri. Jampi itu berkesan dengan cepat padanya, membengkakkan dagu dan lehernya, seperti dia tiba-tiba menghidap penyakit gondok.

06e324e4de2b.en: The spectators around all looked intrigued, awaiting Sora to come out of her shell. Meanwhile, talking in the background started.
06e324e4de2b.t: Para penonton di sekeliling semuanya kelihatan tertarik, menunggu Sora keluar dari cengkerangnya. Sementara itu, perbualan di latar belakang bermula.

07061dc62387.en: Kibe, now also with a swollen neck and chin from applying the same spell on himself, while Neferteri was going about her business, lifted his badge kinda above his head—perhaps an unwillingness to go all the way up, or a certain air of laziness. He then unscrambled a folded paper from his pocket, and read it as confidently as a college student presenting a research paper he threw together the night before. “Yesterday, Gabiro screwed up a research spell trying to get Fanchakis to be larger. He says he is sorry, but he can’t come in today, so I'm covering for him.” He put his badge away, and put the rolled contract up in the air instead. “If Harry wins, he will get Maiara’s hand. If he loses, he’s gonna have a debt of five hundred sapphires and work as Sanbi-eye until the debt is repaid.”
07061dc62387.t: Kibe, kini turut berleher dan berdagu bengkak kerana menggunakan jampi yang sama pada dirinya, sementara Neferteri sibuk dengan urusannya, mengangkat lencananya lebih kurang di atas kepalanya—mungkin kerana enggan mengangkat sepenuhnya, atau aura malas tertentu. Dia kemudian membuka kertas berlipat dari poketnya, dan membacanya seyakin pelajar kolej yang membentangkan kertas kajian yang disiapkan semalaman. “Semalam, Gabiro merosakkan jampi kajian yang cuba membesarkan Fanchaki. Dia kata dia minta maaf, tapi dia tak dapat datang hari ni, jadi aku gantikan dia.” Dia menyimpan lencananya, dan mengangkat kontrak yang digulung itu ke udara pula. “Kalau Harry menang, dia akan dapat tangan Maiara. Kalau dia kalah, dia akan ada hutang lima ratus sapphire dan kerja sebagai Sanbi-eye sehingga hutang tu dibayar.”

0735543816ab.en: Harry’s heart skipped a beat, feeling like someone punched his guts from the inside. With rushed steps, he made his way towards Kibe, and kept himself to no more than two steps away from him, nearly stepping on his shoes. They walked past the large boxy castle, revealing to Harry what was beyond it for the first time, a large wooden door with a highly intricate jumping Sanbi blue fish illustration about the height of two men. *Eiri never mentioned that—*feeling an urge to know more, Harry could not help himself. “Excuse me—sorry, but why?”
0735543816ab.t: Jantung Harry terhenti sedetik, terasa seperti seseorang menumbuk perutnya dari dalam. Dengan langkah tergesa-gesa, dia menuju ke arah Kibe, dan menjaga dirinya tidak lebih daripada dua langkah darinya, hampir memijak kasutnya. Mereka berjalan melepasi istana besar berbentuk kotak itu, mendedahkan kepada Harry apa yang ada di sebaliknya buat pertama kali, sebuah pintu kayu besar dengan ilustrasi ikan biru Sanbi yang melompat yang sangat rumit kira-kira setinggi dua orang lelaki. *Eiri tak pernah sebut pasal tu—*merasakan desakan untuk tahu lebih lanjut, Harry tidak dapat menahan diri. “Maafkan saya—maaf, tapi kenapa?”

083fa2d7700e.en: Sora revealed her tomato-red face to the public, and quickly smelled Harry’s hand. Closing her eyes, she stuck out her tongue to lick his hand, right in the same spot as she did to Maiara—between the middle and ring fingers. She seemingly kept trying to taste something as her mouth grew slack, only to then face Eiri with an open stare. “I’m sorry king-maid, but my senses are off.” Her saddening speech was not its usual rap-pace, more like G-funk.
083fa2d7700e.t: Sora menunjukkan wajahnya yang merah seperti tomato kepada orang ramai, dan dengan cepat menghidu tangan Harry. Memejamkan mata, dia menjelirkan lidahnya untuk menjilat tangannya, betul-betul di tempat yang sama seperti yang dilakukannya kepada Maiara—antara jari tengah dan jari manis. Dia nampaknya terus cuba merasa sesuatu sementara mulutnya menjadi longgar, hanya untuk kemudian menghadap Eiri dengan renungan kosong. “Maaf king-maid, tapi deria saya tak betul.” Ucapannya yang sedih tidak selaju rap biasanya, lebih seperti G-funk.

085225c1b549.en: Four steps away, three, two—Harry felt like his knife was getting close to making contact, but then he saw Maiara’s leg fly through the air, towards his neck, where he did not even feel the pain, or pressure of it making contact—a true roundhouse kick of someone who knows what they were doing.
085225c1b549.t: Empat langkah lagi, tiga, dua—Harry merasakan pisaunya semakin hampir mengenai sasaran, tetapi kemudian dia melihat kaki Maiara terbang di udara, ke arah lehernya, di mana dia tidak merasakan pun kesakitan, atau tekanan sentuhannya—tendangan pusing sebenar seseorang yang tahu apa yang dilakukannya.

099e32a7242b.en: Itagiba, with a relaxed expression, and gleeful smile continued his royally upbeat speech, raising his voice further, to the edge of a scream. “SANBI-EYE OR MAIARA’S HAND! EITHER WAY, HARRY WILL BECOME ONE OF US, AND HELP PROTECT YOU ALL!”
099e32a7242b.t: Itagiba, dengan riak santai, dan senyuman gembira meneruskan ucapan dirajanya yang bersemangat, meninggikan lagi suaranya, hingga ke tahap menjerit. “SANBI-EYE ATAU TANGAN MAIARA! YANG MANA PUN, HARRY AKAN JADI SEBAHAGIAN DARIPADA KITA, DAN BANTU MELINDUNGI KAMU SEMUA!”

0a2377d3ba3c.en: The crowd cheered once again, but this time the rowdiness and sheer excitement were tamed down. Not that they were less excited per se, but just something about Neferteri’s energy not being as raw as Itagiba’s.
0a2377d3ba3c.t: Orang ramai bersorak sekali lagi, tetapi kali ini kebisingan dan keterujaan mereka lebih terkawal. Bukannya mereka kurang teruja, tetapi ada sesuatu tentang tenaga Neferteri yang tidak semetah tenaga Itagiba.

0a439f7cd89d.en: One of those tiny humanoids flew by his head, then suddenly hovered, halting its forward movement. Waving with a welcoming smile, this tiny humanoid looked like a hostess at a bar—dressed like one too even, including wearing a large belt pouch on the side, which one could assume was for money.
0a439f7cd89d.t: Salah satu makhluk kecil berupa manusia itu terbang melintasi kepalanya, kemudian tiba-tiba berlegar, menghentikan pergerakannya ke depan. Melambai dengan senyuman mesra, makhluk kecil ini kelihatan seperti pelayan wanita di bar—malah berpakaian seperti itu juga, termasuk memakai pundi tali pinggang besar di sisi, yang boleh diandaikan untuk duit.

0a8a3ca5ed18.en: Harry and Maiara exchanged glances. Harry stood there, still, seeing Maiara take a deep breath, holding her anger from punching him in the face—or feeding her anger by staring at him with an intent to punch him in the face. It was hard to tell, to be honest. She then walked off towards Neferteri, leaving Harry all alone amongst the strangers walking about.
0a8a3ca5ed18.t: Harry dan Maiara bertukar pandangan. Harry berdiri di situ, kaku, melihat Maiara menarik nafas dalam, menahan kemarahannya daripada menumbuk mukanya—atau menyuburkan kemarahannya dengan merenungnya dengan niat menumbuk mukanya. Sukar untuk dipastikan, jujurnya. Dia kemudian berjalan pergi ke arah Neferteri, meninggalkan Harry bersendirian di kalangan orang asing yang berjalan ke sana ke mari.

0bd967d889b5.en: Meanwhile, the public’s volume increased, while a bald man of tall stature, wearing blue and black rags, spit on the ground near Harry “So you were a druggy from the slums, huh? Get the fuck out of here! MAIARA! Choose me instead! I GOT BIG DICK ENERGY—!”
0bd967d889b5.t: Sementara itu, bunyi orang ramai semakin kuat, manakala seorang lelaki botak bertubuh tinggi, memakai kain buruk biru dan hitam, meludah ke tanah berhampiran Harry “Jadi kau penagih dari setinggan, ya? Berambus dari sini! MAIARA! Pilih aku je! AKU ADA AURA KONEK BESAR—!”

0e9139000558.en: The passerby looked at Harry, then Itagiba, then touched his finger on the side of his forehead, and then moved it forward, like he was tipping an imaginary hat, and disappeared into the crowd.
0e9139000558.t: Orang yang lalu-lalang itu memandang Harry, kemudian Itagiba, kemudian menyentuh jarinya di sisi dahinya, dan kemudian menggerakkannya ke depan, seperti mengangkat topi khayalan, dan hilang ke dalam orang ramai.

0eddd2b1932c.en: “Get over here! If you stray too far, you will be killed by the guards.” Kibe was a ways forward, glancing back at Harry.
0eddd2b1932c.t: “Datang sini! Kalau kau merayau terlalu jauh, kau akan dibunuh pengawal.” Kibe agak jauh ke depan, menoleh ke arah Harry.

1075166cbcaa.en: Harry gripped his bloodied blade, but deep inside him the mental picture of stabbing someone clashed against the roaring energy from the crowd that filled his spirit. Harry stood there, quite a few steps away from Maiara, tremblingly holding his knife with one hand, while the other was slumbering on the side, hanging like dead meat on a butcher shop display. Harry’s breath began turning shallower and shallower, until he held his breath, and ran towards her with his knife in front, pointing at her gut. “ARRRHHHHH” He let out a high-pitched scream that sounded more like he was being tortured.
1075166cbcaa.t: Harry menggenggam bilahnya yang berdarah, tetapi jauh di dalam dirinya gambaran mental menikam seseorang bertembung dengan tenaga orang ramai yang mengaum yang memenuhi semangatnya. Harry berdiri di situ, agak jauh dari Maiara, memegang pisaunya dengan menggeletar dengan sebelah tangan, sementara tangan yang lagi satu terkulai di sisi, tergantung seperti daging mati di pameran kedai daging. Nafas Harry mula menjadi semakin cetek, sehingga dia menahan nafas, dan berlari ke arahnya dengan pisaunya di depan, menghala ke perutnya. “ARRRHHHHH” Dia mengeluarkan jeritan nyaring yang lebih kedengaran seperti dia sedang diseksa.

128dfa27914c.en: What do you—want from me! Harry tried to speak, but his mouth only murmured and gargled nonsense into the pillow. The nonsense turned into a grunt when a newfound pressure began on his neck, not even really hurting this time. Coincidentally, not long after Harry felt like he forgot something. Something important—like someone at his door, knocking for his attention, but he did not expect anyone to stop by today. Ahh—it’s fine. His thoughts began to murk into one another, tethering on the verge of losing consciousness, where life or death are both a step away. Seeing everything black, not even knowing which way is up, kinda reminded him of when he was in the red recliner watching TV, eating tacos and drinking beer. The beer tasted so refreshingly crispy, as if it just came out of a near frozen tap. The tacos were so fresh it appeared the cooker from the taco shop had come to his house and made it especially for him—maybe it was him that knocked at the door? On the TV he saw a greenish light, but then his eyes adjusted, and he suddenly saw a familiar ceiling basked in a green light. Home?
128dfa27914c.t: Apa yang kau—nak daripada aku! Harry cuba bercakap, tetapi mulutnya hanya bergumam dan berkumur karut ke dalam bantal. Karut itu bertukar menjadi rengusan apabila tekanan baharu bermula di lehernya, malah tidak benar-benar menyakitkan kali ini. Secara kebetulan, tidak lama kemudian Harry merasakan seperti dia terlupa sesuatu. Sesuatu yang penting—seperti seseorang di pintunya, mengetuk untuk mendapatkan perhatiannya, tetapi dia tidak menjangka sesiapa akan singgah hari ini. Ahh—tak apalah. Fikirannya mula keruh bercampur antara satu sama lain, terikat di ambang hilang kesedaran, di mana hidup atau mati sama-sama selangkah jauhnya. Melihat segala-galanya hitam, tidak tahu pun arah mana yang atas, agak mengingatkannya ketika dia berada di kerusi malas merah menonton TV, makan taco dan minum bir. Bir itu terasa begitu rangup menyegarkan, seolah-olah baru keluar dari paip yang hampir membeku. Taco itu begitu segar sehingga seolah-olah tukang masak dari kedai taco datang ke rumahnya dan membuatnya khas untuknya—mungkin dialah yang mengetuk pintu? Di TV dia nampak cahaya kehijauan, tetapi kemudian matanya menyesuaikan diri, dan dia tiba-tiba nampak siling yang dikenali bermandikan cahaya hijau. Rumah?

1538450529f1.en: The weight of the sword almost broke Harry’s wrist—at least that’s what Harry felt as the sword bent forward, and struck the ground. The intensity of the strike rattled Harry’s bones, almost straining his muscles in the process, while also catching the attention, and laughter of some passersby.
1538450529f1.t: Berat pedang itu hampir mematahkan pergelangan tangan Harry—sekurang-kurangnya itulah yang Harry rasa ketika pedang itu melendut ke depan, dan menghentam tanah. Keamatan hentaman itu menggegarkan tulang Harry, hampir menegangkan ototnya dalam proses itu, sambil turut menarik perhatian, dan ketawa beberapa orang yang lalu-lalang.

15a5a52dc2fd.en: The public all seemed to remember something, triggering a bunch of laughter, driving the attention away from Harry, while also leaving him cluelessly out of the conversation.
15a5a52dc2fd.t: Orang ramai semuanya seakan-akan teringat sesuatu, mencetuskan banyak ketawa, mengalihkan perhatian dari Harry, sambil turut meninggalkannya tanpa tahu apa-apa tentang perbualan itu.

161e019b3991.en: Continuing what appeared to be a ritual, Sora smelled her hair, then her neck, upper back, then focused on her arms and hands. She licked Maiara right in the space between her middle and ring fingers, and tasted the result like she was enjoying the plate of prosciutto, all before returning to smell her chest and face. Turning to Kibe, she shook her head as she once again grasped her maid skirt—while not even managing to make eye contact, of course.
161e019b3991.t: Meneruskan sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti ritual, Sora menghidu rambut Maiara, kemudian lehernya, belakang atasnya, kemudian menumpukan perhatian pada lengan dan tangannya. Dia menjilat Maiara betul-betul di ruang antara jari tengah dan jari manisnya, dan merasa hasilnya seperti dia menikmati sepinggan prosciutto, sebelum kembali menghidu dada dan wajahnya. Berpaling kepada Kibe, dia menggeleng sambil sekali lagi menggenggam skirt pembantu rumahnya—sementara tidak berjaya pun bertentang mata, sudah tentu.

16d5789b21a5.en: The crowd roared. Beer mugs were raised, beer was spilled by some, and the crowd packed closely around this semi-circular-ish space, eager to watch the live event.
16d5789b21a5.t: Orang ramai mengaum. Kole bir diangkat, bir tertumpah oleh sesetengah orang, dan orang ramai berasak-asak di sekeliling ruang yang agak separuh bulatan ini, tidak sabar menonton acara secara langsung itu.

17de600e1aab.en: Harry, meanwhile, looked around, seeing a mix of facial expressions towards him. Is five hundred that bad? He looked towards Eiri for an answer, but all she provided was a simple slow nod with her thin lips.
17de600e1aab.t: Harry, sementara itu, memandang sekeliling, melihat campuran riak wajah ke arahnya. Lima ratus tu teruk sangat ke? Dia memandang ke arah Eiri untuk jawapan, tetapi yang diberikannya hanyalah anggukan perlahan yang ringkas dengan bibir menipis.

17eed6514e42.en: Harry felt a shiver down his spine, letting out a quick moan when a small, moistly warm thing—coincidentally in the shape of Sora’s tongue—gave him a quick lick in the neck. Breaking the rules, he looked at the perpetrator, mid-tasting something with a tight face—maybe whatever she was tasting was probably over seasoned, at least based on how she seemed to be salivating heavily as her eyes strained. Although, she now kinda looked like a cat having a brain freeze, putting her cutesy tongue out, and shaking her head.
17eed6514e42.t: Harry merasakan gigilan di tulang belakangnya, mengeluarkan erangan pantas apabila sesuatu yang kecil, lembap dan hangat—secara kebetulan berbentuk lidah Sora—menjilat lehernya dengan pantas. Melanggar peraturan, dia memandang pelakunya, yang sedang merasa sesuatu dengan wajah tegang—mungkin apa sahaja yang dirasanya terlebih perasa, sekurang-kurangnya berdasarkan bagaimana dia kelihatan meleleh air liur dengan banyak sementara matanya tegang. Walaupun, kini dia kelihatan agak seperti kucing yang mengalami otak beku, menjelirkan lidahnya yang comel, dan menggeleng kepalanya.

186eb1aa3f6c.en: A loud gasp came from Harry, trying to breathe in, but a suffocating darkness prevented him from grabbing much air. Whaaaat? Harry was slowly growing spatially aware. He felt like he was dying in the darkness again, but this time he could not see the same light that was zooming around like before—until it suddenly clicked in, and he awakened, trying to breathe again, noticing a weight on his back, and himself being pressured against the bed he was sleeping in.
186eb1aa3f6c.t: Satu tercungap kuat datang dari Harry, cuba menarik nafas, tetapi kegelapan yang menyesakkan menghalangnya daripada mendapat banyak udara. Apaaaa? Harry perlahan-lahan semakin sedar akan ruang di sekelilingnya. Dia merasakan seperti dia sedang mati dalam kegelapan lagi, tetapi kali ini dia tidak dapat melihat cahaya yang sama yang meluncur ke sana ke mari seperti dahulu—sehinggalah tiba-tiba dia tersedar, dan dia terjaga, cuba bernafas semula, perasan ada berat di belakangnya, dan dirinya ditekan ke katil tempat dia tidur.

19900868e3c9.en: Chapter VI - Fate · Vol 1 - Failed Experiment · #HusbandOutWorld
19900868e3c9.t: Bab VI - Takdir · Jilid 1 - Eksperimen Gagal · #HusbandOutWorld

19a6c55b191e.en: Harry, resting against the softness of the bed sheets, looked at this male figure, wearing a black long-sleeved undershirt that contrasted with a blue and gold sleeveless thin sweater. Vaguely looking towards this male figure, he finally remembered who he was, specifically when Sora spoke after him during dinner. “K—ibe?”
19a6c55b191e.t: Harry, bersandar pada kelembutan cadar katil, memandang susuk lelaki ini, yang memakai baju dalam lengan panjang hitam yang kontras dengan baju sejuk nipis tanpa lengan biru dan emas. Memandang samar-samar ke arah susuk lelaki ini, dia akhirnya teringat siapa dia, khususnya ketika Sora bercakap dengannya semasa makan malam. “K—ibe?”

1b0c20d27e00.en: Without waiting for Sora to finish, Maiara crouched down as she closed her eyes, keeping her hands wide to the side.
1b0c20d27e00.t: Tanpa menunggu Sora habis, Maiara mencangkung sambil memejamkan matanya, mengekalkan tangannya terbuka luas ke sisi.

1b24a01586ea.en: “If Maiara says it’s fine.” Itagiba raised his bottle, then proceeded to suck on it again, while Neferteri did a slow nod, raising her badge.
1b24a01586ea.t: “Kalau Maiara kata okey.” Itagiba mengangkat botolnya, kemudian terus menghisapnya lagi, manakala Neferteri mengangguk perlahan, mengangkat lencananya.

1df48e34b60c.en: Eiri glanced towards Neferteri, and saw her sipping on a fine wine. Eiri drew a long breath, and looked back at Harry. “Go Harry! Go Harry!” She chanted alongside everyone else.
1df48e34b60c.t: Eiri mengerling ke arah Neferteri, dan melihatnya menghirup wain yang halus. Eiri menarik nafas panjang, dan memandang semula Harry. “Ayuh Harry! Ayuh Harry!” Dia melaungkan bersama semua orang lain.

2194ce023eee.en: “Rrruuugggghhh” The humanoid made a low cat-like purr, mixed with a lion grunt, looking down on Harry.
2194ce023eee.t: “Rrruuugggghhh” Makhluk berupa manusia itu mengeluarkan dengkuran rendah seperti kucing, bercampur rengusan singa, memandang ke bawah ke arah Harry.

23509c3d38a6.en: Just like a loud clap, everything became nothingness. Harry felt like his body had melted away, leaving him the sensation that he was in a dark void, with no center, or escape.
23509c3d38a6.t: Sama seperti tepukan kuat, segala-galanya menjadi kekosongan. Harry merasakan seperti tubuhnya telah cair, meninggalkannya dengan sensasi bahawa dia berada dalam kehampaan gelap, tanpa pusat, atau jalan keluar.

23b5e83a8947.en: A nervous smile came out of Harry, feeling some of his tension being levitated away by the rather fatherly, or at least uncle-like spirit oozing from Itagiba. He brought the sword closer to view, and saw the words “Sanbi Royal” carved in red in the cyan blade. The sword looked real—it felt real.
23b5e83a8947.t: Senyuman gugup keluar daripada Harry, merasakan sebahagian ketegangannya diterbangkan oleh semangat kebapaan, atau sekurang-kurangnya seperti pak cik, yang terpancar dari Itagiba. Dia mendekatkan pedang itu untuk dilihat, dan nampak perkataan “Sanbi Royal” diukir dengan warna merah pada bilah biru kehijauan itu. Pedang itu kelihatan sebenar—ia terasa sebenar.

23c8cdd59470.en: Harry went to open the door, but he paused instead. Looking for a way out, he glanced towards the drawers, remembering when Eiri pulled a towel out of one. Luckily for him, there were a few, so he wrapped one of them on his lower back, and made his way back to the bedroom, where Kibe was still at the door, facing the stairs. Harry, by reflex, smiled slightly as they made eye contact. He really does not sound happy.
23c8cdd59470.t: Harry hendak membuka pintu, tetapi sebaliknya dia terhenti. Mencari jalan keluar, dia mengerling ke arah laci, teringat ketika Eiri mengeluarkan tuala dari salah satunya. Nasib baik baginya, ada beberapa helai, jadi dia membalut sehelai di pinggang bawahnya, dan kembali ke bilik tidur, di mana Kibe masih di pintu, menghadap tangga. Harry, secara refleks, tersenyum sedikit ketika mereka bertentang mata. Dia memang tak bunyi gembira.

26a1ccf03be8.en: Harry slightly furrowed his brow. But I am not from the slums, right? He glanced towards Eiri, but she was busy attending to Sora.
26a1ccf03be8.t: Harry mengerutkan dahi sedikit. Tapi aku bukan dari setinggan, kan? Dia mengerling ke arah Eiri, tetapi dia sibuk melayan Sora.

2781915256c2.en: Itagiba raised his badge, making the thudding stop. “Y’ALL READY?”
2781915256c2.t: Itagiba mengangkat lencananya, menghentikan dentuman itu. “KAMU SEMUA DAH SEDIA?”

2947df839605.en: “—Hence, we created this event ruled by a customized Gandew Duel. Death will not determine the loser, but rather the inability to defend one’s position. All other rules shall remain original to its nature.” Neferteri lowered her badge, and looked towards Kibe, giving a nod.
2947df839605.t: “—Oleh itu, kami mencipta acara ini yang dikawal oleh Pertarungan Gandew yang diubah suai. Kematian tidak akan menentukan pihak yang kalah, sebaliknya ketidakmampuan untuk mempertahankan kedudukan seseorang. Semua peraturan lain kekal asli mengikut sifatnya.” Neferteri menurunkan lencananya, dan memandang ke arah Kibe, memberi anggukan.

29cd1e9cd215.en: Harry’s hands now felt like touching her badge—amongst other things of hers, but that was just one of the thoughts rushing through his mind at the moment as everything felt so foreign.
29cd1e9cd215.t: Tangan Harry kini terasa ingin menyentuh lencananya—di antara benda-benda lain miliknya, tetapi itu hanyalah salah satu fikiran yang menerpa dalam fikirannya pada ketika itu kerana segala-galanya terasa begitu asing.

29da659c7dbc.en: Avoiding eye contact, Sora approached him. “Excuse me, sir Harry—” She crouched, and began sniffing him up the same way as Maiara, including the same private-smelling course of action—which made him tense up as he sometimes could feel her puffs of air—also her cutesy face looking like she was about to give head probably did not help his wildly wavering mental status.
29da659c7dbc.t: Mengelak bertentang mata, Sora mendekatinya. “Maafkan saya, Tuan Harry—” Dia mencangkung, dan mula menghidunya dengan cara yang sama seperti Maiara, termasuk tindakan menghidu kemaluan yang sama—yang membuatkannya tegang kerana kadang-kadang dia dapat merasakan hembusan nafasnya—wajahnya yang comel yang kelihatan seperti dia hendak melakukan seks oral mungkin juga tidak membantu status mentalnya yang terumbang-ambing liar.

2a32852d5dce.en: The Sanbi royals, watching over the duel, didn’t seem too keen to celebrate either, except for Nina, the small pink princess. Her hands were up in the air as she ran towards the food and candy stands, only to have Neferteri tell a nearby maid to watch over her. Eori kept to herself, seemingly silently enjoying the party.
2a32852d5dce.t: Sanbi royal, yang mengawasi pertarungan itu, tidak kelihatan terlalu ghairah untuk berpesta juga, kecuali Nina, puteri kecil berbaju merah jambu. Tangannya diangkat ke udara ketika dia berlari ke arah gerai makanan dan gula-gula, hanya untuk Neferteri menyuruh seorang pembantu rumah berdekatan mengawasinya. Eori menyendiri, nampaknya menikmati pesta itu dalam diam.

2c3b33b98364.en: “FUCK! That took a while.” Now an angrier voice came from whoever was pinning down Harry, releasing him from a death by suffocation. A nice pop sound came next, sounding awfully similar to when Eiri had popped the nari gel open.
2c3b33b98364.t: “SIAL! Lama juga tu.” Kini suara yang lebih marah datang dari sesiapa yang menyepit Harry, melepaskannya dari kematian akibat lemas. Bunyi pop yang sedap menyusul, kedengaran amat serupa dengan ketika Eiri membuka nari gel itu.

2dd765cf4051.en: The audience celebrated. “Owwww! Game is on!” A random person screamed out loud amongst the cheers.
2dd765cf4051.t: Penonton bersorak. “Owwww! Permainan bermula!” Seseorang yang rawak menjerit kuat di tengah-tengah sorakan.

2e3eab537f3c.en: “Who are you?” The girl placed her hand on his neck, ready to suffocate him, as the rest of her naked body lay on top of him.
2e3eab537f3c.t: “Kau ni siapa?” Gadis itu meletakkan tangannya di leher Harry, bersedia untuk mencekiknya, sementara baki tubuhnya yang bogel berbaring di atasnya.

2ed1804594cf.en: Chapter VI subchapter 1: in a dark green-lit room, a green-skinned figure looms over a dark-haired person lying below.
2ed1804594cf.t: Bab VI subbab 1: dalam bilik bercahaya hijau gelap, satu susuk berkulit hijau menjulang di atas seseorang berambut gelap yang terbaring di bawah.

30f1f7a42405.en: What check? Harry felt ticklish inside his mind, dumping more curiosity, with a hint of sexual drive to the swirling pools of emotions within him.
30f1f7a42405.t: Pemeriksaan apa? Harry merasakan geli dalam fikirannya, melonggokkan lebih banyak rasa ingin tahu, dengan sedikit dorongan seksual ke dalam kolam emosi yang berpusar dalam dirinya.

31d79ac129f4.en: Harry looked at his hand. A green wooden badge, about the size of a credit card, just like Eiri’s, now rested on his hands, but this time the name Harry Sanbi was carved instead. A faint smell came from it, and when Harry sniffed it closer, he could smell burnt wood—revealing just how fresh the badge was. “It’s my badge!” Harry held the badge with both hands, feeling a piece of himself in this world as the heavy door began to creak open towards them.
31d79ac129f4.t: Harry memandang tangannya. Sebuah lencana kayu hijau, kira-kira sebesar kad kredit, sama seperti Eiri punya, kini terletak di tangannya, tetapi kali ini nama Harry Sanbi yang diukir. Bau samar datang daripadanya, dan apabila Harry menghidunya lebih dekat, dia dapat menghidu bau kayu terbakar—mendedahkan betapa barunya lencana itu. “Ini lencana saya!” Harry memegang lencana itu dengan kedua-dua tangan, merasakan sebahagian dirinya di dunia ini ketika pintu yang berat itu mula berkeriut terbuka ke arah mereka.

31eaf366c0c6.en: There’s a lot of people here. Harry’s eyes saw a sea of skin colors and body sizes. Humans, some skinny, some muscly, and some even thick, or EXTRA THICC as some would put it. This wide spectrum also applied to humanoids ranging from tiny, baby-size versions of Sora to inhumanly tall and strong versions of Sora—about as strong as an orc too. So that’s what Sorefaries, Wozefaries, and Darfaries look like. Harry noticed the size of the canine teeth poking out did change according to how big or small they were, just like the book he had glanced over yesterday. The same book also had a detailed examination of the entrails on the next page—which looked just like any other human on the inside. Harry tried to kill that gross thought, concentrating back in the real world.
31eaf366c0c6.t: Ramainya orang kat sini. Mata Harry melihat lautan warna kulit dan saiz badan. Manusia, sesetengahnya kurus, sesetengahnya berotot, dan sesetengahnya malah montok, atau EXTRA THICC seperti yang dikatakan sesetengah orang. Spektrum yang luas ini turut terpakai kepada makhluk berupa manusia yang berjulat dari versi Sora yang kecil sebesar bayi hingga versi Sora yang tinggi dan kuat luar biasa—kira-kira sekuat orc juga. Jadi macam tu rupa Sorefaries, Wozefaries dan Darfaries. Harry perasan saiz gigi taring yang menjengul memang berubah mengikut betapa besar atau kecilnya mereka, sama seperti buku yang sempat dikerlingnya semalam. Buku yang sama juga mempunyai pemeriksaan terperinci tentang isi perut di halaman seterusnya—yang kelihatan sama seperti mana-mana manusia lain di dalamnya. Harry cuba membunuh fikiran menjijikkan itu, menumpukan perhatian semula pada dunia nyata.

320e27396add.en: “Now this is some good shit. Have you seen it before? Of course you haven’t.” Itagiba did not even let Harry say a word before he tilted the shield-looking artifact so Harry could see the front, where it would be flush with someone’s wrist when worn, “It’s like a shield, but you wear it on your wrist.”
320e27396add.t: “Haa, ni barang bagus. Kau pernah nampak sebelum ni? Mestilah tak.” Itagiba tidak membiarkan Harry berkata sepatah pun sebelum dia menyengetkan artifak seperti perisai itu supaya Harry dapat melihat bahagian depan, di mana ia akan rata dengan pergelangan tangan seseorang apabila dipakai, “Ia macam perisai, tapi kau pakai kat pergelangan tangan.”

326d11ec36ac.en: “Yo! Harry! Get in the center!” Stopping suckling his beer like it was a baby bottle, Itagiba waved his hand towards the big circular-ish open area in front of them.
326d11ec36ac.t: “Yo! Harry! Pergi ke tengah!” Berhenti menghisap birnya seperti botol susu bayi, Itagiba melambaikan tangannya ke arah kawasan lapang besar yang agak bulat di hadapan mereka.

338ae9ea74ae.en: Harry, slowly moving his eyes down to the perpetrator, saw a familiar girly figure with long purple hair, her perky breasts had tantalizing nipples, deliriously calling for someone to suck them. Her wide vicious grin, like a hyena about to kill its prey, shone in the green moonlight. He saw her before, but just could not register who it was even though her face was clearly visible in the green moonshine. The girl spoke something unintelligible towards him, then slapped him in the face. He could not even feel the slap as he saw her vicious pink eyes staring at him. He then felt a pressure on his neck that intensified with each passing second. He gargled, and murmured unintelligible groans in response. Suddenly, he saw her licking her hand, and then moving it between her thighs, adjusting herself towards him, where she began to stroke her hips on his mouth and nose. He saw her tastefully play with her erect nipples in the bask of the green moonlight; at least for a bit as somehow the room was growing darker, and darker.
338ae9ea74ae.t: Harry, perlahan-lahan menggerakkan matanya ke bawah ke arah pelaku, nampak susuk tubuh gadis yang dikenali berambut ungu panjang, buah dadanya yang tegang mempunyai puting yang menggoda, seakan-akan meracau memanggil seseorang untuk menghisapnya. Sengihan lebarnya yang ganas, seperti dubuk yang hendak membunuh mangsanya, bersinar dalam cahaya bulan hijau. Dia pernah melihatnya sebelum ini, tetapi tidak dapat mengecam siapa walaupun wajahnya jelas kelihatan dalam cahaya bulan hijau. Gadis itu mengatakan sesuatu yang tidak dapat difahami kepadanya, kemudian menampar mukanya. Dia tidak dapat merasakan tamparan itu pun ketika dia melihat mata merah jambunya yang ganas merenungnya. Dia kemudian merasakan tekanan di lehernya yang semakin kuat setiap detik yang berlalu. Dia berkumur, dan bergumam erangan yang tidak dapat difahami sebagai balasan. Tiba-tiba, dia melihat gadis itu menjilat tangannya, dan kemudian menggerakkannya ke celah pehanya, menyesuaikan dirinya ke arahnya, di mana dia mula menggeselkan pinggulnya pada mulut dan hidung Harry. Dia melihat gadis itu bermain dengan nikmat dengan putingnya yang tegang dalam cahaya bulan hijau; sekurang-kurangnya seketika kerana entah bagaimana bilik itu semakin gelap, dan gelap.

33ba9d9c07f7.en: “Uhhh—no?” Harry raised the shortsword, and the strapped shield. “I don’t think I ever fought before.”
33ba9d9c07f7.t: “Uhhh—tak?” Harry mengangkat pedang pendek itu, dan perisai yang terikat. “Rasanya saya tak pernah bertarung sebelum ni.”

33be188127ae.en: A Darfaries, a humanoid race nearly twice as tall as humans, spoke after, in a firm and deeper tone, almost like an orc grunt. “No, you stupid Brunto! The king hasn’t shown up in ages. He’s gonna find where new Sanbi fishing spots are!”
33be188127ae.t: Seorang Darfaries, bangsa berupa manusia yang hampir dua kali ganda tinggi manusia, bercakap selepas itu, dengan nada tegas dan lebih garau, hampir seperti rengusan orc. “Bukan, kau Brunto bodoh! Raja tu dah lama tak muncul. Dia akan cari tempat memancing Sanbi yang baru!”

34f5ca15a0c4.en: Harry watched the ritual unfold alongside the eagerly anticipating audience. That’s weird. Is she trying to find something? Harry noticed how Sora’s small nose was wide open, taking small, quick breaths pretty close to Maiara’s skin, sometimes even tasting the air as well. Harry’s mind felt something familiar about it, like he had seen this before, but somehow a human, or at least a humanoid figure doing it seemed off. Until suddenly his mind struck gold—well, more like pyrite, but it was better than nothing now that he had a faint recollection of his family dog sniffing the large taco on his hand—or perhaps it was his hand that was child size, and made the taco look big. Haven’t seen any dogs around either—I thought they were more common.
34f5ca15a0c4.t: Harry menonton ritual itu berlangsung bersama penonton yang menanti dengan penuh debar. Peliknya. Dia cuba cari sesuatu ke? Harry perasan betapa hidung kecil Sora terbuka luas, menarik nafas kecil dan pantas agak dekat dengan kulit Maiara, kadang-kadang malah merasa udara juga. Fikiran Harry merasakan sesuatu yang biasa tentangnya, seperti dia pernah melihat ini sebelum ini, tetapi entah bagaimana manusia, atau sekurang-kurangnya susuk berupa manusia melakukannya terasa tidak kena. Sehinggalah tiba-tiba fikirannya menemui emas—lebih kepada pirit sebenarnya, tetapi lebih baik daripada tiada kerana kini dia mempunyai ingatan samar tentang anjing keluarganya menghidu taco besar di tangannya—atau mungkin tangannya yang sebesar tangan kanak-kanak, dan membuatkan taco itu kelihatan besar. Tak nampak anjing langsung kat sini—aku ingat anjing lebih biasa.

373924ea8f85.en: Maiara, a not-so-girly woman, dropped her hammer, and posed ready to defend with her fists, as if the bell of a boxing match was about to strike. She bit her lips, concentrating on her only enemy.
373924ea8f85.t: Maiara, wanita yang tidak berapa keanak-gadisan, menjatuhkan tukulnya, dan bersiap sedia untuk bertahan dengan penumbuknya, seolah-olah loceng perlawanan tinju hendak berbunyi. Dia menggigit bibirnya, menumpukan perhatian pada satu-satunya musuhnya.

37831234cf5b.en: The passerby narrowed his eyes. “You really think so? He doesn’t look agile enough to be using that.” He pointed his head towards the short sword Harry was carrying.
37831234cf5b.t: Orang yang lalu-lalang itu mengecilkan matanya. “Kau betul-betul fikir macam tu? Dia tak nampak cukup tangkas untuk guna benda tu.” Dia menghalakan kepalanya ke arah pedang pendek yang dibawa Harry.

3acb62b5d14c.en: The crowd turned their attention to Harry. Meanwhile, Harry stood there, shakily holding his badge, sweating nervously as the curious eyeballs of everyone around apparently all waited for him to do something.
3acb62b5d14c.t: Orang ramai mengalihkan perhatian mereka kepada Harry. Sementara itu, Harry berdiri di situ, memegang lencananya dengan menggeletar, berpeluh gugup sementara biji mata semua orang di sekeliling yang ingin tahu nampaknya menunggu dia melakukan sesuatu.

3ace8d5e7aa5.en: Harry’s arms and legs felt slightly sore, as if he had done a bit too much elliptical. He looked at Kibe, still not saying anything as they reached the first floor. “Where are we going to duel?”
3ace8d5e7aa5.t: Lengan dan kaki Harry terasa sedikit sengal, seolah-olah dia terlebih menggunakan mesin elips. Dia memandang Kibe, yang masih tidak berkata apa-apa ketika mereka sampai di tingkat satu. “Kat mana kita akan bertarung?”

3d5f2da3c14c.en: Hearing Eiri’s voice above the background, Harry felt the throbbing pain wane, and his heart raced once again. This energy blowing up from within cleared his lungs enough for him to take deeper, but still hasty breaths. He leaned forward and took a few wobbly steps towards the shortsword he had dropped, leaving a trail of blood contrasting the rocky gray ground. He picked up his shortsword with his bloodied right hand, staining its cyan shiny appeal.
3d5f2da3c14c.t: Mendengar suara Eiri mengatasi latar belakang, Harry merasakan kesakitan yang berdenyut itu reda, dan jantungnya berlumba sekali lagi. Tenaga yang meletup dari dalam ini melegakan paru-parunya cukup untuk dia menarik nafas yang lebih dalam, tetapi masih tergesa-gesa. Dia membongkok ke depan dan mengambil beberapa langkah terhuyung-hayang ke arah pedang pendek yang dijatuhkannya, meninggalkan jejak darah yang kontras dengan tanah kelabu berbatu. Dia mengambil pedang pendeknya dengan tangan kanannya yang berdarah, mengotorkan daya tarikan berkilat biru kehijauannya.

3f6522a1e1a3.en: Harry’s eyes could not stop noticing the number of blue tickets he saw people carrying, alongside beer and snacks. The same purple meat he had eaten yesterday at dinnertime now was offered in thighs or kebab style in the hands of some of the people he saw around him, with some others also carrying beer mugs and other snacks. Everyone seemed to be having a good time, as if they were in a stadium watching football, while he felt the thuds chill him to his bones.
3f6522a1e1a3.t: Mata Harry tidak dapat berhenti perasan banyaknya tiket biru yang dia nampak orang ramai bawa, bersama bir dan snek. Daging ungu yang sama yang dimakannya semalam semasa makan malam kini ditawarkan dalam bentuk peha atau gaya kebab di tangan sesetengah orang yang dia nampak di sekelilingnya, dengan sesetengah yang lain turut membawa kole bir dan snek lain. Semua orang kelihatan berseronok, seolah-olah mereka berada di stadium menonton bola sepak, sementara dia merasakan dentuman itu menyejukkan hingga ke tulangnya.

407687ce365d.en: “You forgot your clothes! And fix your hair too!” Kibe spoke loudly, ensuring Harry would hear across the bathroom door.
407687ce365d.t: “Kau lupa pakaian kau! Dan betulkan rambut kau juga!” Kibe bercakap dengan kuat, memastikan Harry akan mendengar dari sebalik pintu bilik mandi.

40d965ba9c45.en: “I’m—sorry.” Still following Kibe’s footsteps, Harry looked back to the humanoid—or more like alligator-noid—with a mix of shrug and surrender. His face held back fear as he heard another grunt, but this time sounding more tame than before. As he passed by a fountain, towards an open area, Harry sighed in relief after finally seeing a few familiar faces: Sora, Eiri, Neferteri, Itagiba, and others.
40d965ba9c45.t: “Sa—saya minta maaf.” Masih mengikut jejak langkah Kibe, Harry menoleh ke arah makhluk berupa manusia itu—atau lebih tepat berupa buaya—dengan campuran angkat bahu dan menyerah. Wajahnya menahan ketakutan ketika dia mendengar satu lagi rengusan, tetapi kali ini kedengaran lebih jinak daripada tadi. Ketika dia melintasi air pancut, menuju ke kawasan lapang, Harry mengeluh lega selepas akhirnya melihat beberapa wajah yang dikenali: Sora, Eiri, Neferteri, Itagiba, dan yang lain.

41044c036cb4.en: “You better get fucking ready, you Nari worm!” Maiara showed her grin, taking back steps from Harry while maintaining a strong, firm eye-contact.
41044c036cb4.t: “Baik kau bersedia, cacing Nari celaka!” Maiara menunjukkan seringainya, berundur beberapa langkah dari Harry sambil mengekalkan pandangan mata yang kuat dan tegas.

411927554dc2.en: Kibe did not smile back; he just looked back to the stairs. “Get it over with.”
411927554dc2.t: Kibe tidak tersenyum balik; dia cuma memandang semula ke tangga. “Cepat siapkan.”

43082634f617.en: “Good. So, now let’s go over the basics. A dice will be thrown, and if it lands on the color you choose, you make a single attack.” Itagiba threw his arms as if he was doing a down swipe attack. He then defended himself, throwing his muscly arm out in front, and bending back to take the brunt of an imaginary attack. “Otherwise you defend. The catch is that you can’t evade, or you will automatically lose. You have to take the brunt of the attack.”
43082634f617.t: “Bagus. Jadi, sekarang jom kita lalui asas-asasnya. Sebiji dadu akan dibaling, dan kalau ia mendarat pada warna yang kau pilih, kau buat satu serangan.” Itagiba menghayunkan lengannya seolah-olah dia melakukan serangan libasan ke bawah. Dia kemudian mempertahankan dirinya, menghulurkan lengannya yang berotot ke depan, dan membongkok ke belakang untuk menahan serangan khayalan. “Kalau tak kau bertahan. Masalahnya kau tak boleh mengelak, kalau tak kau automatik kalah. Kau kena tahan serangan tu.”

470a12a313d3.en: The alligator humanoid crouched down, and helped him sit up, only to hear him grunt in pain as his left arm, still tied to the shield on his forearm, happened to move slightly on its own all over—in ways a break dancer would only dream of.
470a12a313d3.t: Makhluk berupa buaya itu mencangkung, dan membantunya duduk, hanya untuk mendengarnya merengus kesakitan ketika lengan kirinya, masih terikat pada perisai di lengan bawahnya, secara kebetulan bergerak sedikit dengan sendirinya ke merata arah—dalam cara yang hanya diimpikan oleh penari break dance.

482ff371d411.en: Harry, following Kibe’s step without a hitch, stepped out of the castle walls, towards the outside world into what appeared a large roundabout in front of him, with a large fountain decorating the middle. In that fountain stood another large Sanbi fish, but this time in the form of a statue.
482ff371d411.t: Harry, mengikut langkah Kibe tanpa sebarang masalah, melangkah keluar dari tembok istana, ke arah dunia luar ke dalam sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti bulatan jalan yang besar di hadapannya, dengan air pancut besar menghiasi bahagian tengah. Di air pancut itu berdiri seekor lagi ikan Sanbi yang besar, tetapi kali ini dalam bentuk patung.

4af4fca304fc.en: The passerby looked at the royal vibe oozing from Itagiba, specifically how his sapphire crusted gems on his neck shone in the sun. “I already placed my bet.” The passerby took out a blue ticket from within his pocket.
4af4fca304fc.t: Orang yang lalu-lalang itu memandang aura diraja yang terpancar dari Itagiba, khususnya bagaimana permata bertatahkan sapphire di lehernya bersinar di bawah matahari. “Aku dah buat taruhan aku.” Orang yang lalu-lalang itu mengeluarkan tiket biru dari dalam poketnya.

4cda4347a8a8.en: Dave, the stranger with apparently big dick energy, was now silently huffing under his own breath, crossing his arms as if someone chopped off his energy source.
4cda4347a8a8.t: Dave, orang asing yang nampaknya beraura konek besar itu, kini mendengus senyap sendirian, memeluk tubuh seolah-olah seseorang telah memotong sumber tenaganya.

4d19cb2d5de3.en: “He looks normal—what would he have injected on his neck?” Harry heard a guy in green clothes, standing close by speaking out loud.
4d19cb2d5de3.t: “Dia nampak normal—apa yang dia suntik kat leher dia agaknya?” Harry mendengar seorang lelaki berpakaian hijau, yang berdiri berdekatan bercakap dengan kuat.

4e10c2ff144d.en: The sound of hinges screaming as they made their best to keep the heavy door afloat echoed everywhere. Two guards appeared, each pushing a side of the door with all their might. Their clothing had a darker blue accent to them, with fish leather texture on both the tank-top-like shirt and helmet. The clothing overall looked light, agile, while the helmet had extra protection, with a dark stripe around the eyes—likely to block off excess sun. As a choice of style over function, the helmet also had a large blue Mohawk, similar to ancient Roman helmets, but more like a dollar store rip-off version of it. On the front, they carried two small knives, and a fanny pack. On the back, they carried a bow and quivers. The bow also had a receptacle just below where the arrow was strung, coincidentally for something just about the size of a nari gel—possibly where arrows would get dipped right before drawing the bow.
4e10c2ff144d.t: Bunyi engsel menjerit ketika ia berusaha sedaya upaya mengekalkan pintu yang berat itu terapung bergema di merata tempat. Dua orang pengawal muncul, masing-masing menolak sebelah pintu dengan sepenuh tenaga. Pakaian mereka berhias biru lebih gelap, dengan tekstur kulit ikan pada baju seperti singlet dan topi keledar. Pakaian keseluruhannya kelihatan ringan dan tangkas, manakala topi keledar mempunyai perlindungan tambahan, dengan jalur gelap di sekeliling mata—mungkin untuk menghalang cahaya matahari berlebihan. Sebagai pilihan gaya berbanding fungsi, topi keledar itu juga mempunyai jambul Mohawk biru yang besar, serupa dengan topi keledar Rom purba, tetapi lebih seperti versi tiruan kedai dua ringgit. Di depan, mereka membawa dua bilah pisau kecil, dan beg pinggang. Di belakang, mereka membawa busur dan tabung anak panah. Busur itu juga mempunyai bekas tepat di bawah tempat anak panah dipasang, secara kebetulan untuk sesuatu yang kira-kira sebesar nari gel—mungkin tempat anak panah dicelup sebelum busur ditarik.

511dc5c3d42b.en: “Just go check his Darfaries interface already!” Kibe, with his arms crossed, loudly spoke towards the guest star of the dueling show, still in her shell, hiding behind Eiri.
511dc5c3d42b.t: “Pergi periksa antara muka Darfaries dia cepat!” Kibe, dengan tangan bersilang, bercakap dengan kuat ke arah bintang jemputan pertunjukan pertarungan itu, yang masih dalam cengkerangnya, bersembunyi di belakang Eiri.

51dcbc85abe3.en: The crowd cheered back, starting to move around, including into the open area.
51dcbc85abe3.t: Orang ramai bersorak balas, mula bergerak ke sana ke mari, termasuk ke kawasan lapang itu.

531099727690.en: “Nobody fucking asked you, small prick!” Showing him the middle finger, Maiara replied faster than the guy could finish his sentence.
531099727690.t: “Tak ada siapa tanya kau, konek kecik!” Menunjukkan jari tengah kepadanya, Maiara menjawab lebih cepat daripada lelaki itu sempat menghabiskan ayatnya.

5385e48eff59.en: Itagiba, the king of Sanbi, let out a small burp before raising his voice against the whispering crowd. “WELCOME MY SANBI FRIENDS!” He spoke as loudly as he could, but not loud enough to strain his voice. Successfully taming the crowds with an energy only a few have, his darker, elite-looking badge written in red ink went high up in the air. The corners had four distinctly colored shiny balls, going from top-right red, blue, green, and finishing with yellow on the top-left. Itagiba rotated his hand around, making sure everyone could see the glimmering red light from the thermometer-like apparatus.
5385e48eff59.t: Itagiba, raja Sanbi, bersendawa kecil sebelum meninggikan suaranya kepada orang ramai yang berbisik-bisik. “SELAMAT DATANG KAWAN-KAWAN SANBI AKU!” Dia bercakap sekuat yang dia mampu, tetapi tidak cukup kuat untuk menegangkan suaranya. Berjaya menjinakkan orang ramai dengan tenaga yang hanya dimiliki segelintir orang, lencananya yang lebih gelap dan kelihatan elit yang ditulis dengan dakwat merah diangkat tinggi ke udara. Bucu-bucunya mempunyai empat bebola berkilat yang berlainan warna, dari kanan atas merah, biru, hijau, dan berakhir dengan kuning di kiri atas. Itagiba memusingkan tangannya, memastikan semua orang dapat melihat cahaya merah yang berkilauan dari alat seperti termometer itu.

551fd35872ed.en: Someone else close by sharply spoke back, eagerly, and confidently saying, “He’s gonna watch out for THE Sanbi King!” Harry looked towards the voice, and saw a skinny guy, about his height, but far older. His pure white hair showed he was well into retirement—assuming he was not one of those people that only stop working when they literally drop dead.
551fd35872ed.t: Seseorang lain berdekatan membalas dengan tajam, bersemangat, dan yakin berkata, “Dia akan berjaga-jaga untuk Sanbi King YANG ITU!” Harry memandang ke arah suara itu, dan nampak seorang lelaki kurus, kira-kira setinggi dia, tetapi jauh lebih tua. Rambutnya yang putih bersih menunjukkan dia sudah lama bersara—dengan andaian dia bukan salah seorang daripada mereka yang hanya berhenti bekerja apabila mereka benar-benar rebah dan mati.

568262a0b03b.en: “Lower your badge, you little cunt,” Maiara spoke again through her dangerous grin towards Harry, apparently trying to keep the show on some sort of rails, making her anger now seem less genuine. Perhaps her toothy grinning, grinding teeth, and overall scary expression were more like a “Game on, bitch” type of thing, rather than actual hatred towards Harry.
568262a0b03b.t: “Turunkan lencana kau, puki kecil,” Maiara bercakap lagi melalui seringainya yang berbahaya ke arah Harry, nampaknya cuba memastikan pertunjukan itu kekal di landasan tertentu, membuatkan kemarahannya kini kelihatan kurang tulen. Mungkin seringainya yang menampakkan gigi, gigi yang berketap, dan riak keseluruhannya yang menakutkan lebih kepada jenis “Jom lawan, sundal”, bukannya kebencian sebenar terhadap Harry.

57a264a92c19.en: Fainting cheers ensued, with some claps here, some alligator grunts there—nothing to fawn over, but it wasn’t completely silent either—Harry probably needed to invest a few more skill points in public speaking as he seeped the energy away from the crowd that Itagiba had initially infused.
57a264a92c19.t: Sorakan lemah menyusul, dengan beberapa tepukan di sini, beberapa rengusan buaya di sana—tiada apa yang perlu dikagumi, tetapi tidaklah sunyi sepenuhnya juga—Harry mungkin perlu melaburkan beberapa mata kemahiran lagi dalam pengucapan awam kerana dia menyedut tenaga yang mula-mula disuntik Itagiba ke dalam orang ramai.

59aa84096597.en: Squeezing the corners of her maid dress, Sora looked down in shame, as if she was a shy girl about to ask a boy for prom in a high school corridor—in front of everyone, of course.
59aa84096597.t: Memerah sudut gaun pembantu rumahnya, Sora menunduk malu, seolah-olah dia gadis pemalu yang hendak mengajak seorang lelaki ke majlis prom di koridor sekolah menengah—di depan semua orang, sudah tentu.

5b2dd1a10f44.en: Harry noticed that the shield had logogram pairs sticking out, all looking awfully similar to the ones on the sigil rings—with one being the same pair of logograms Eiri had used to heal his sliced thumb. Another pair had four parallel lines with a plus logogram, with another stranger pair beside it also composed of two logograms, one of a body with the hands blacked out, and a circle with arrows pointing outward.
5b2dd1a10f44.t: Harry perasan perisai itu mempunyai pasangan logogram yang menonjol, semuanya kelihatan amat serupa dengan yang ada pada cincin sigil—dengan satu pasangan logogram yang sama yang Eiri gunakan untuk menyembuhkan ibu jarinya yang terhiris. Satu lagi pasangan mempunyai empat garis selari dengan logogram tambah, dengan satu lagi pasangan yang lebih aneh di sebelahnya juga terdiri daripada dua logogram, satu tubuh dengan tangan dihitamkan, dan bulatan dengan anak panah menghala ke luar.

5d125ce8bf13.en: Now standing between them, Sora quickly hid her badge in the shallow depth of her breasts. Looking ready to speak, Sora’s head appeared as if it was gonna merge with her torso. “If you pardon me, Princess Maiara Sanbi! I need to perform the check—” The embarrassed words barely got out as she spoke as fast as she could, then bowed towards Maiara as if she was apologizing for having to commit the utmost sin of mankind.
5d125ce8bf13.t: Kini berdiri di antara mereka, Sora cepat-cepat menyembunyikan lencananya dalam celah buah dadanya yang cetek. Kelihatan bersedia untuk bercakap, kepala Sora kelihatan seolah-olah ia akan bercantum dengan badannya. “Jika Puteri Maiara Sanbi sudi memaafkan saya! Saya perlu melakukan pemeriksaan—” Kata-kata malu itu hampir tidak keluar kerana dia bercakap selaju yang dia mampu, kemudian menunduk ke arah Maiara seolah-olah dia memohon maaf kerana terpaksa melakukan dosa paling besar umat manusia.

5d9566945465.en: “Can we just get this—” The bathroom door opened. “Oh—feeling the pressure?” Kibe still held the contract in his hand, holding the bathroom door half-open.
5d9566945465.t: “Boleh tak kita selesaikan je—” Pintu bilik mandi terbuka. “Oh—rasa tertekan ke?” Kibe masih memegang kontrak di tangannya, memegang pintu bilik mandi separuh terbuka.

5dddf1dfaa02.en: “C’mon, Harry! You can do this! Fuck her up the ass!” A random person in the audience crouched by Harry, and offered one of his hands, while the other was tightly holding a bundle of blue tickets.
5dddf1dfaa02.t: “Ayuh, Harry! Kau boleh! Liwat dia!” Seorang penonton rawak mencangkung di sebelah Harry, dan menghulurkan sebelah tangannya, sementara tangan yang lagi satu memegang erat seikat tiket biru.

5eb6efb6dce9.en: Being precise in her timing, Neferteri continued her speech right as the crowd’s cheering started to die down. “For that, we wanted to select a proper representative, one we can bestow duties for an extended period of time, ensuring he will be able to properly understand your needs, and your life experiences. With that said, I would like to introduce you all to Harry Sanbi.” Neferteri slowly raised her hand towards Harry, with a slight smile tugging the corners of her mouth—remaining as elegant as ever.
5eb6efb6dce9.t: Tepat dalam pemasaannya, Neferteri meneruskan ucapannya tepat ketika sorakan orang ramai mula reda. “Untuk itu, kami mahu memilih seorang wakil yang sesuai, yang boleh kami amanahkan tugas untuk tempoh yang panjang, memastikan dia akan dapat memahami keperluan kamu, dan pengalaman hidup kamu dengan sebaiknya. Dengan itu, saya ingin memperkenalkan kepada kamu semua Harry Sanbi.” Neferteri perlahan-lahan mengangkat tangannya ke arah Harry, dengan senyuman kecil menarik sudut mulutnya—kekal anggun seperti biasa.

6256fcec5a61.en: Harry looked back at Kibe, holding out with an extended fist, appearing to want to fist bump. Being a fine gentleman, Harry fist bumped him.
6256fcec5a61.t: Harry memandang semula Kibe, yang menghulurkan penumbuk, kelihatan mahu berlaga penumbuk. Sebagai lelaki budiman, Harry melagakan penumbuk dengannya.

673033b41646.en: Without saying a word, Kibe carefreely walked down the spiral stairs, without even looking back to Harry to ensure he was following him.
673033b41646.t: Tanpa berkata sepatah pun, Kibe turun tangga berpusar dengan selamba, tanpa menoleh ke arah Harry untuk memastikan dia mengikutinya.

67ef2eed6a62.en: As Harry approached Itagiba, someone of corpulent body size, wearing a straw hat with a red tree accent on it, intervened between them. “Itagiba!” He sounded pretty cheery, if not liquored up as well.
67ef2eed6a62.t: Ketika Harry mendekati Itagiba, seseorang bertubuh gempal, memakai topi jerami dengan hiasan pokok merah, mencelah di antara mereka. “Itagiba!” Dia kedengaran agak ceria, kalau bukan juga sudah mabuk.

693fae0b13a1.en: We’re here to have fun? Harry looked at Neferteri, coming closer to her husband.
693fae0b13a1.t: Kita kat sini nak berseronok? Harry memandang Neferteri, yang semakin mendekati suaminya.

6aad85f788eb.en: “Sir—please crouch down, extend your arms and close your eyes.” The girly voice coming from within Sora barely got out—her rosacea looked so brightly red that one could fear she was having a high fever.
6aad85f788eb.t: “Tuan—tolong mencangkung, hulurkan lengan dan pejamkan mata.” Suara gadis dari dalam Sora hampir tidak keluar—rosaseanya kelihatan begitu merah terang sehingga orang mungkin bimbang dia demam panas.

6cfa73364f41.en: “You do it.” Kibe’s uncaring voice clapped back like a slap.
6cfa73364f41.t: “Kau ambil sendiri.” Suara Kibe yang tidak peduli membalas seperti tamparan.

6d47caffcbf4.en: Meanwhile, the concoction was still spreading throughout his entire body, bringing a cool, refreshing sensation that gave way to a slowly growing numbing, and paralyzing effect all over his body, with the extremities feeling more strongly the initial impact. “Urgh!” He tried to roll his entire body to the side, desperately, but whoever this girl was, she must have known how to pin someone down. At least he was able to bend his neck backward a bit to gather some needed fresh air, but doing so triggered an additional surge of pain from whatever was stabbing him in the neck—like as if he had a neck strain. He groaned, trying to scream with all the might he had “LEMME OUT! LEMME—humpf!”
6d47caffcbf4.t: Sementara itu, campuran itu masih merebak ke seluruh tubuhnya, membawa sensasi sejuk dan menyegarkan yang memberi laluan kepada kesan kebas dan lumpuh yang perlahan-lahan meningkat di seluruh tubuhnya, dengan hujung anggota merasakan hentakan awal dengan lebih kuat. “Urgh!” Dia cuba menggulingkan seluruh tubuhnya ke sisi, dengan terdesak, tetapi siapa pun gadis ini, dia pasti tahu cara menyepit seseorang. Sekurang-kurangnya dia dapat membengkokkan lehernya ke belakang sedikit untuk mendapatkan udara segar yang diperlukan, tetapi berbuat demikian mencetuskan lonjakan kesakitan tambahan dari apa sahaja yang sedang menikamnya di leher—seolah-olah lehernya terseliuh. Dia mengerang, cuba menjerit dengan sepenuh kekuatan yang ada padanya “LEPASKAN AKU! LEPAS—humpf!”

6f3637c2e755.en: Chapter VI subchapter 3: a crowded street scene with Harry in his blue uniform among many people and stalls.
6f3637c2e755.t: Bab VI subbab 3: adegan jalanan yang sesak dengan Harry dalam pakaian seragam birunya di kalangan ramai orang dan gerai.

6f6d4042d606.en: The king of Sanbi, Itagiba, called Harry over with a wide hand motion as he walked to the side of the table where the weapons were all laid out.
6f6d4042d606.t: Raja Sanbi, Itagiba, memanggil Harry dengan gerakan tangan yang luas ketika dia berjalan ke sisi meja di mana senjata-senjata semuanya disusun.

7229bf2244d7.en: Appearing from amongst the people on the other side, a familiar, strong-looking lady stomped towards him, with a berserker aura around her. She grinned her teeth like a savage animal, while her knuckles were white from how tight her fist was.
7229bf2244d7.t: Muncul dari celah orang ramai di sebelah sana, seorang wanita yang dikenali dan kelihatan kuat menghentak kaki ke arahnya, dengan aura pahlawan mengamuk di sekelilingnya. Dia menyeringai menampakkan gigi seperti haiwan buas, sementara buku limanya putih kerana betapa ketatnya penumbuknya.

733e7550117c.en: “Good. Hope you win! But remember, the kingdom will win either way, and that’s what really matters.” Itagiba nodded, with his face right up to Harry. “Right, Harry?”
733e7550117c.t: “Bagus. Harap kau menang! Tapi ingat, kerajaan akan menang yang mana pun, dan itulah yang paling penting.” Itagiba mengangguk, dengan wajahnya betul-betul di depan Harry. “Kan, Harry?”

7a83dbc6f4a5.en: Looking at his badge, slightly shaking in his hands, Harry slowly raised it above his head. The glimmer coming out of the red thermometer-like apparatus only covered a small portion of the thinner bar, but it was nonetheless visible to everyone.
7a83dbc6f4a5.t: Memandang lencananya, yang sedikit menggeletar di tangannya, Harry perlahan-lahan mengangkatnya ke atas kepala. Kilauan yang keluar dari alat seperti termometer merah itu hanya meliputi sebahagian kecil bar yang lebih nipis, tetapi ia tetap kelihatan kepada semua orang.

7b08a082b5ed.en: Harry felt something rhythmically strike him in the face, pressuring him. Wake up. He heard a voice inside his mind, but the voice did not sound like his. This thing, still striking his head, grew in pressure, and intensity. In the middle of what appeared to be a boot up from a deep, but unrestful slumber, his mind slowly grew aware of his surroundings. That was until he suddenly had a flashback to something on top of him, somehow asphyxiating him. With a loud gasp, seeking for air as if he was underwater for five minutes, Harry snapped back into reality.
7b08a082b5ed.t: Harry merasakan sesuatu memukul mukanya secara berirama, menekannya. Bangun. Dia mendengar satu suara dalam fikirannya, tetapi suara itu tidak kedengaran seperti suaranya. Benda ini, masih memukul kepalanya, semakin kuat tekanan dan keamatannya. Di tengah-tengah sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti but semula dari lena yang dalam tetapi tidak tenang, fikirannya perlahan-lahan semakin sedar akan persekitarannya. Sehinggalah dia tiba-tiba teringat kembali sesuatu di atasnya, entah bagaimana melemaskannya. Dengan tercungap kuat, mencari udara seolah-olah dia berada di bawah air selama lima minit, Harry tersentak kembali ke alam nyata.

7b2b9ad24fee.en: A hum came out of Kibe, sizing Harry up and down from his back.
7b2b9ad24fee.t: Satu dengungan keluar daripada Kibe, menilai Harry dari atas ke bawah dari belakang.

7bfe7fe563b8.en: Maiara, meanwhile, nodded at the words Neferteri stated, letting through a temporary grinned smile amidst her voracity to combat Harry. There was clearly enjoyment coursing through her anger, imagining doing something to Harry that he himself could not even fathom.
7bfe7fe563b8.t: Maiara, sementara itu, mengangguk mendengar kata-kata Neferteri, membiarkan senyuman menyeringai sementara terlepas di tengah-tengah kerakusannya untuk melawan Harry. Jelas ada keseronokan mengalir dalam kemarahannya, membayangkan melakukan sesuatu kepada Harry yang dia sendiri tidak dapat bayangkan.

7d5fe53db84a.en: Maiara gripped her hands on her tribal hammer, showing Harry that its edges looked painfully bone-breaking blunt. Her head bounced to the rhythm of the beat, seemingly concentrating on something as her face looked more serious than angry.
7d5fe53db84a.t: Maiara menggenggam tukul puaknya, menunjukkan kepada Harry bahawa tepinya kelihatan tumpul yang menyakitkan dan boleh mematahkan tulang. Kepalanya mengangguk mengikut rentak irama, nampaknya menumpukan perhatian pada sesuatu kerana wajahnya kelihatan lebih serius daripada marah.

7e5f11966c24.en: A thinner gentleman, a few steps away, in blue Sanbi scale clothing, spoke back “SHUT UP, DAVE! We all know what you did with the Sanbi heads.”
7e5f11966c24.t: Seorang lelaki yang lebih kurus, beberapa langkah jauhnya, berpakaian sisik Sanbi biru, membalas “DIAMLAH, DAVE! Kami semua tahu apa yang kau buat dengan kepala-kepala Sanbi tu.”

80f17f00d75b.en: Neferteri cleared her throat, and raised her badge high up, showing to everyone that it had the same bioluminescence as her husband’s, while her badge was the same wood green color as everyone else's, including Harry’s badge. “Yes, my lovely people, this is a new program we are experimenting with to ensure all the needs, specifically the citizens from distant villages, are all heard in an official manner.” Her voice sounded like she was shouting from the top of her lungs, but it did not sound coarse, or strained at all, as if she had a megaphone built-in on her throat.
80f17f00d75b.t: Neferteri berdehem, dan mengangkat lencananya tinggi-tinggi, menunjukkan kepada semua orang bahawa ia mempunyai biopendarcahaya yang sama seperti lencana suaminya, manakala lencananya berwarna hijau kayu yang sama seperti lencana orang lain, termasuk lencana Harry. “Ya, rakyatku yang dikasihi, ini ialah program baharu yang sedang kami cuba untuk memastikan semua keperluan, khususnya rakyat dari kampung-kampung terpencil, didengari secara rasmi.” Suaranya kedengaran seperti dia menjerit sekuat hati, tetapi ia langsung tidak kedengaran kasar atau tegang, seolah-olah dia mempunyai pembesar suara terbina dalam kerongkongnya.

81c764116e58.en: The roundabout was packed with people, in what appeared to be a street party. They gave way to both Kibe and Harry.
81c764116e58.t: Bulatan jalan itu penuh sesak dengan orang, dalam sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti pesta jalanan. Mereka memberi laluan kepada Kibe dan Harry.

81c88ee8617a.en: “It’s time, Nefi?” Itagiba looked at her, expecting she would not say a word.
81c88ee8617a.t: “Dah masanya, Nefi?” Itagiba memandangnya, menjangkakan dia tidak akan berkata sepatah pun.

82478c6e3881.en: “You'll see,” Kibe curtly replied, scratching his neck using the contract as he stepped on a random child’s drawing resting on the floor, with a few crayons hanging by it.
82478c6e3881.t: “Kau tengok nanti,” Kibe menjawab ringkas, menggaru lehernya menggunakan kontrak itu sambil memijak lukisan kanak-kanak yang rawak di lantai, dengan beberapa batang krayon di sebelahnya.

82739ddfac24.en: “Argh.” The gray-haired man grabbed Harry’s hand and slapped whatever he was holding into it. “Don’t lose it!” He turned back towards the door, and cleared his throat. “BY THE ORDER OF KIBE SANBI ROYAL! OPEN THE DOORS!”
82739ddfac24.t: “Argh.” Lelaki berambut kelabu itu memegang tangan Harry dan menampar apa sahaja yang dipegangnya ke dalamnya. “Jangan hilangkan!” Dia berpaling semula ke arah pintu, dan berdehem. “DENGAN PERINTAH KIBE SANBI ROYAL! BUKA PINTU!”

829e1f8e0cae.en: Fenafo sized up Harry, and patted him on the shoulder. “Uffda—good luck boy!” He walked closer to Itagiba, and said something in his ear.
829e1f8e0cae.t: Fenafo menilai Harry, dan menepuk bahunya. “Uffda—semoga berjaya, budak!” Dia berjalan mendekati Itagiba, dan membisikkan sesuatu di telinganya.

8367217d65df.en: Harry felt his tactile senses come back. His face was warm, and he felt a tingle on his forehead. He tried to move his left arm, but it did not respond to him. His left shoulder did, and it was in the form of an excruciating pain, as if someone had shoved a knife on it. He tried to stand up, but only cried out in pain instead.
8367217d65df.t: Harry merasakan deria sentuhnya kembali. Mukanya hangat, dan dia merasakan kesemutan di dahinya. Dia cuba menggerakkan lengan kirinya, tetapi ia tidak bertindak balas. Bahu kirinya bertindak balas, dan ia dalam bentuk kesakitan yang amat sangat, seolah-olah seseorang telah menyumbat pisau ke dalamnya. Dia cuba berdiri, tetapi sebaliknya hanya menjerit kesakitan.

8706b48d6cc0.en: “Yo! Fenafo! Long time no see! Enjoying the party?” Itagiba shook hands with the man, which then turned into a hug with a slap in the back.
8706b48d6cc0.t: “Yo! Fenafo! Lama tak jumpa! Seronok pesta ni?” Itagiba bersalam dengan lelaki itu, yang kemudian bertukar menjadi pelukan dengan tamparan di belakang.

8780b3c3c13e.en: “YES! Check this shit out!” Itagiba held up a square-looking artifact with spikes on the front.
8780b3c3c13e.t: “YA! Tengok benda celaka ni!” Itagiba mengangkat sebuah artifak berbentuk segi empat dengan pepaku di bahagian depan.

87ad86857612.en: “Just get it over with.” Maiara placed her feet evenly spaced apart and her hands straight out to the sides, while her angered face shifted into an eye-rolling one.
87ad86857612.t: “Cepat siapkan je.” Maiara meletakkan kakinya terbuka sama jarak dan tangannya lurus ke sisi, sementara wajahnya yang marah bertukar menjadi menjuling mata.

88e17f2f1819.en: “Agrhrhh—It hurts! It hurts! I want to go home!” Tears streamed down Harry’s face, throbbing stabbing pain that was so intense he could barely breathe. With his right hand, he cleaned away the blood and tears of his face, only to see that his entire hand was a vivid red, dripping blood in his tight clothes. His sense of smell and taste came back as well, confirming the metallic notes of his own blood, constantly rolling down on his face.
88e17f2f1819.t: “Agrhrhh—Sakit! Sakit! Saya nak balik rumah!” Air mata mengalir di wajah Harry, kesakitan menikam yang berdenyut begitu kuat sehingga dia hampir tidak dapat bernafas. Dengan tangan kanannya, dia mengesat darah dan air mata di wajahnya, hanya untuk melihat seluruh tangannya merah terang, menitiskan darah ke pakaiannya yang ketat. Deria bau dan rasanya juga kembali, mengesahkan nota logam darahnya sendiri, yang sentiasa mengalir di wajahnya.

8a20cbc3e4ba.en: “Gimme your arm.” Itagiba unbuttoned the strap inside the shield and started strapping firmly on Harry’s left forearm. “All right, Harry. You know what to do with these, right?”
8a20cbc3e4ba.t: “Bagi lengan kau.” Itagiba membuka butang tali di dalam perisai itu dan mula mengikatnya dengan kemas pada lengan bawah kiri Harry. “Okey, Harry. Kau tahu apa nak buat dengan benda ni, kan?”

8b7b18a61509.en: “Yes—I’m Kibe. Now go get dressed! Everyone is waiting, and I’m not gonna get blamed for it!” Kibe, not exactly looking entertained, pointed the rolled up bloodied contract towards the bathroom.
8b7b18a61509.t: “Ya—aku Kibe. Sekarang pergi berpakaian! Semua orang tengah tunggu, dan aku tak nak kena salahkan!” Kibe, tidak kelihatan terhibur langsung, menghalakan kontrak berdarah yang digulung itu ke arah bilik mandi.

8cab1fd6f49e.en: “Fine. I call the checking done!” Kibe lowered the contract, and stepped back to merge with the audience.
8cab1fd6f49e.t: “Baiklah. Aku isytiharkan pemeriksaan selesai!” Kibe menurunkan kontrak itu, dan berundur untuk bercampur dengan penonton.

90fe5f68db6e.en: Chapter VI subchapter 6: a furious girl with a red-tipped blade confronts Harry on a city street.
90fe5f68db6e.t: Bab VI subbab 6: seorang gadis yang berang dengan bilah berhujung merah berhadapan dengan Harry di jalan kota.

949b3eb98ec4.en: “Of course I am! Great to see Maiara find someone she likes!” The man held Harry’s shoulder. “I hope you will protect her well!” Looking at Princess Maiara, talking with Neferteri not far off, he let out a belly laugh. “Hahaha—well, not that you’d have to do much—right? Hehehe—” Fenafo, a man of corpulent size, belly laughed as he saw Itagiba browsing through the weapons.
949b3eb98ec4.t: “Mestilah! Seronok tengok Maiara jumpa seseorang yang dia suka!” Lelaki itu memegang bahu Harry. “Harap kau akan lindungi dia dengan baik!” Memandang Puteri Maiara, yang bercakap dengan Neferteri tidak jauh dari situ, dia ketawa terbahak-bahak. “Hahaha—yalah, bukannya kau perlu buat banyak pun—kan? Hehehe—” Fenafo, lelaki bertubuh gempal itu, ketawa terbahak-bahak ketika melihat Itagiba meninjau senjata-senjata itu.

97bcdaf5df7e.en: Walking towards him, Sora pulled out her badge from between her small breasts, and raised it above her head, as high as she could, even going as far as raising her feet and walking like a ballerina to see if it helped everyone notice her—it didn’t, but it was a cute attempt nonetheless.
97bcdaf5df7e.t: Berjalan ke arahnya, Sora mengeluarkan lencananya dari celah buah dadanya yang kecil, dan mengangkatnya ke atas kepala, setinggi yang dia mampu, malah sampai berjengket dan berjalan seperti penari balet untuk melihat sama ada ia membantu semua orang perasan dirinya—tidak membantu, tetapi ia percubaan yang comel juga.

988146654772.en: Gulping, Harry nodded at the king of Sanbi. I guess I’m not gonna say anything else.
988146654772.t: Menelan liur, Harry mengangguk kepada raja Sanbi. Rasanya aku takkan cakap apa-apa lagi.

9a2aa8bc5f64.en: “Aurgh! Arugh!” The humanoid alligator agreed—maybe, at least it sounded like an agreement noise—or he was trying to bark like a dog.
9a2aa8bc5f64.t: “Aurgh! Arugh!” Makhluk berupa buaya itu bersetuju—mungkin, sekurang-kurangnya ia kedengaran seperti bunyi bersetuju—atau dia cuba menyalak seperti anjing.

9af8f35f9f60.en: “Blue and black!” Maiara replied with certainty with her tone, rotating her shoulders around, as she tightly gripped the hammer.
9af8f35f9f60.t: “Biru dan hitam!” Maiara menjawab dengan kepastian dalam nadanya, memutar bahunya, sambil menggenggam tukul itu erat-erat.

9ef9efd87c89.en: Neferteri closed her eyes, and slowly nodded. Her throat was still swollen, so perhaps she was unable to speak at a normal volume.
9ef9efd87c89.t: Neferteri memejamkan matanya, dan mengangguk perlahan. Kerongkongnya masih bengkak, jadi mungkin dia tidak dapat bercakap dengan suara biasa.

a00c7f054678.en: Feeling his, hers, or its coarse green scales covering its body, Harry felt a faintly cold sensation as he was hugged from the back, and lifted up from the ground.
a00c7f054678.t: Merasakan sisik hijau kasar miliknya yang menutupi tubuhnya, Harry merasakan sensasi sejuk samar ketika dia dipeluk dari belakang, dan diangkat dari tanah.

a1ebac40d614.en: “Ain’t that right? That’s why I gotta find something that helps Harry out.” Itagiba picked up a large black sword with ease, and handed it over towards Harry, “Let’s try this.”
a1ebac40d614.t: “Betul tak? Sebab tu aku kena cari sesuatu yang boleh bantu Harry.” Itagiba mengangkat sebilah pedang hitam besar dengan mudah, dan menghulurkannya kepada Harry, “Jom cuba ni.”

a2a73ba6948e.en: “Don’t worry, Fenafo, I did not forget it!” Itagiba, with a serious tone, gave a bright smile and a nod to Fenafo, watching him part way towards the nearest beer stand. Grabbing a far smaller sword, he exchanged it with Harry. “Remember! The size doesn’t matter, it’s how you penetrate it.” Itagiba smirked.
a2a73ba6948e.t: “Jangan risau, Fenafo, aku tak lupa!” Itagiba, dengan nada serius, memberikan senyuman ceria dan anggukan kepada Fenafo, memerhatinya beredar menuju ke gerai bir terdekat. Mengambil pedang yang jauh lebih kecil, dia menukarnya dengan Harry. “Ingat! Saiz tak penting, yang penting cara kau tusuk.” Itagiba tersenyum sinis.

a364ba519fde.en: “Pfff—like I fucking care! That fake eye ain’t gonna do shit to help him! Just call it already!” Maiara shrugged with a pout as she cracked her necks and hands.
a364ba519fde.t: “Pfff—macamlah aku kisah! Fake eye tu takkan tolong dia langsung! Isytiharkan ajelah!” Maiara mengangkat bahu dengan muncung sambil meletupkan leher dan tangannya.

a45e365221bb.en: Harry walked back to the center where only Harry and Maiara would stand, but there were still quite a few people walking around. Harry’s hands trembled as he began hearing a constant loud thud coming from all over—at least echoing from all over. He looked around, and saw the same semicircular space devoid of people slowly forming around him and Maiara, while guards kept continuously hitting their bows against beer kegs. He felt the realness of the situation begin to set in as his heart sank.
a45e365221bb.t: Harry berjalan kembali ke tengah di mana hanya Harry dan Maiara akan berdiri, tetapi masih ada agak ramai orang berjalan ke sana ke mari. Tangan Harry menggeletar ketika dia mula mendengar bunyi dentuman kuat yang berterusan datang dari merata tempat—sekurang-kurangnya bergema dari merata tempat. Dia memandang sekeliling, dan nampak ruang separuh bulatan yang sama tanpa orang perlahan-lahan terbentuk di sekelilingnya dan Maiara, sementara pengawal-pengawal terus-menerus memukul busur mereka pada tong bir. Dia merasakan realiti keadaan itu mula meresap ketika jantungnya tenggelam.

a6b745d8fad5.en: Eiri returned a smile towards him, but one could see the tremor in her eyes.
a6b745d8fad5.t: Eiri membalas senyuman kepadanya, tetapi orang dapat melihat getaran di matanya.
