a7ca6818b53e.en: Kibe pointed towards Harry, standing still, observing the “check” with an estranged smile. As Sora approached him, he put his hand out, and feet apart just like Maiara. I hope Sora doesn’t start calling me a cunt too.
a7ca6818b53e.t: Kibe menunjuk ke arah Harry, yang berdiri kaku, memerhati “pemeriksaan” itu dengan senyuman janggal. Ketika Sora mendekatinya, dia menghulurkan tangannya, dan membuka kakinya sama seperti Maiara. Harap-harap Sora tak mula panggil aku puki juga.

a80dfee64e44.en: Apparently realizing being caught in the act, she jumped like a kitten being startled, and planted her face in her hands, shaking her head furiously in the process. “Hmhmhmhm—” A lovable embarrassed muffled scream came as she ran towards Eiri, hiding behind her back.
a80dfee64e44.t: Nampaknya menyedari dirinya tertangkap basah, dia melompat seperti anak kucing yang terkejut, dan menekupkan mukanya ke dalam tangannya, menggeleng kepala dengan kuat dalam proses itu. “Hmhmhmhm—” Jeritan malu yang teredam dan comel keluar ketika dia berlari ke arah Eiri, bersembunyi di belakangnya.

a9c2524c803b.en: “Y–yes.” A not-so-confident voice came out of Harry, feeling Itagiba’s muscles squeeze him a bit at the neck.
a9c2524c803b.t: “Y–ya.” Suara yang tidak berapa yakin keluar daripada Harry, merasakan otot Itagiba menghimpitnya sedikit di leher.

aa524897963d.en: A nearby passerby overheard the conversation, and butted in, “Are you saying this is a sham fight?” His dark purple eyes looked like two precious stones. He wore dark red clothing, gray blue hair, and had the same Wozefaries qualities and height as Sora, but he was an older male instead.
aa524897963d.t: Seorang yang lalu-lalang berdekatan terdengar perbualan itu, dan menyampuk, “Kau nak kata ni pertarungan olok-olok ke?” Mata ungu gelapnya kelihatan seperti dua batu permata yang berharga. Dia memakai pakaian merah gelap, berambut biru kelabu, dan mempunyai ciri-ciri Wozefaries dan ketinggian yang sama seperti Sora, tetapi dia seorang lelaki yang lebih tua.

ab5fe6583f71.en: Itagiba let out a nervous chuckle, wrapping Harry in his shoulders. “Of course he fought before! He’s from the slum! We’re talking about Gandew duels, you curious winga!”
ab5fe6583f71.t: Itagiba tergelak gugup, memeluk bahu Harry. “Mestilah dia pernah bertarung! Dia dari setinggan! Kita cakap pasal pertarungan Gandew, kau winga yang suka menyibuk!”

abc2ec31c826.en: Harry waved back, noticing he had the same vein as Sora, but instead of being plain red, it had a faint white flame that seemed to be converted to spewing absolutely black flame, constantly changing its size across the vein appearing in both arms, and meeting on his back—like the monopropellant of a spaceship spewing out from within to finely adjust its orbit. His feet meanwhile, seemed to be dangling freely. Suddenly, Harry felt like he tripped on something, nearly falling on his face.
abc2ec31c826.t: Harry melambai balik, perasan dia mempunyai urat yang sama seperti Sora, tetapi bukannya merah biasa, ia mempunyai api putih samar yang seakan-akan ditukar menjadi memuntahkan api hitam pekat, sentiasa berubah saiz di sepanjang urat yang muncul di kedua-dua lengan, dan bertemu di belakangnya—seperti bahan dorong tunggal kapal angkasa yang memancut dari dalam untuk melaraskan orbitnya dengan halus. Kakinya pula, kelihatan terjuntai bebas. Tiba-tiba, Harry merasakan seperti dia tersandung sesuatu, hampir jatuh tersembam.

afc3d3e171f1.en: The crowd got serious, perhaps even a little exasperated by the words “five hundred sapphires.” Whispering began between some of them, while others somehow turned tail, and started competing to see who would arrive first at a reddish wagon with a sign saying Betting Wagon with an illustration of two large blue tickets, and balls of different colors right below it.
afc3d3e171f1.t: Orang ramai menjadi serius, mungkin sedikit jengkel dengan perkataan “lima ratus sapphire.” Bisik-bisikan bermula di antara sesetengah mereka, manakala yang lain entah bagaimana berpatah balik, dan mula berlumba untuk melihat siapa yang akan sampai dahulu ke sebuah kereta kuda kemerahan dengan papan tanda bertulis Betting Wagon dengan ilustrasi dua tiket biru besar, dan bebola pelbagai warna betul-betul di bawahnya.

b07f5b1f4461.en: “It’s the rules,” Kibe spoke back with an annoyance oozing from his tone, he then turned around, taking out something from his pocket.
b07f5b1f4461.t: “Itu peraturannya,” Kibe membalas dengan rasa jengkel meleleh dari nadanya, dia kemudian berpaling, mengeluarkan sesuatu dari poketnya.

b33772796365.en: With a quick fling of his hand, he threw the dice over the table, making one of the corners clang loudly against the stone pavement. Bouncing in the air, it revealed red on top, but as it landed it clanged again, flipping to show blue on top, then green, then with its last energy, the dice flipped again, showing black on top.
b33772796365.t: Dengan lontaran tangan yang pantas, dia membaling dadu itu melepasi meja, membuatkan salah satu bucunya berdentang kuat di atas turapan batu. Melantun di udara, ia menunjukkan merah di atas, tetapi ketika ia mendarat ia berdentang lagi, terbalik menunjukkan biru di atas, kemudian hijau, kemudian dengan tenaga terakhirnya, dadu itu terbalik lagi, menunjukkan hitam di atas.

b4352ec83e99.en: “But here’s the catch, you can counterattack as long as it is a defensive move.” Itagiba pointed to Harry’s shortsword. “When she is about to strike you, raise the Tolerideme shield so that your arm takes the brunt of it, then stab her in the belly with the other hand.” Itagiba made an okay sign, “That should make things interesting for everyone.”
b4352ec83e99.t: “Tapi ni helahnya, kau boleh serang balas asalkan ia gerakan bertahan.” Itagiba menunjuk ke arah pedang pendek Harry. “Bila dia nak pukul kau, angkat perisai Tolerideme tu supaya lengan kau yang tahan hentaman tu, lepas tu tikam perut dia dengan tangan yang lagi satu.” Itagiba membuat isyarat okey, “Itu patut buat semuanya menarik untuk semua orang.”

b4f59a27ff49.en: “Then get it over with.” Kibe closed the door.
b4f59a27ff49.t: “Kalau macam tu cepat siapkan.” Kibe menutup pintu.

b6612303a06b.en: Cheers came from the rowdy crowd, feeling the energy coming from Itagiba’s willed soul. However, as the second passed a wave of questioning began rising from within. “Sanbi-eye? What’s that?” A stranger’s voice near Harry sounded off.
b6612303a06b.t: Sorakan datang dari orang ramai yang riuh, merasakan tenaga yang datang dari jiwa Itagiba yang berkemahuan kuat. Namun, ketika detik berlalu gelombang persoalan mula timbul dari dalam. “Sanbi-eye? Apa tu?” Suara orang asing berhampiran Harry kedengaran.

b68b1dc62c23.en: Chapter VI subchapter 5: Harry and a young man in blue at a busy market beside a large blue fish statue fountain.
b68b1dc62c23.t: Bab VI subbab 5: Harry dan seorang lelaki muda berpakaian biru di pasar yang sibuk di sebelah pancutan air berpatung ikan biru yang besar.

b7ae3204f80e.en: “Grrrr!” an alligator-like humanoid, with a large snout in its face, stood on two legs, with a large tail protruding from his lower back, from underneath a large shirt that went down its knees. The creature gargled, or grunted as it held its tail in pain. Aside from the simple shirt, this creature also wore a hat with the name Fico written on the sides, plus also what appeared to be a chain around its neck, holding a book with a leather pocket where a charcoal piece stuck out.
b7ae3204f80e.t: “Grrrr!” seekor makhluk berupa manusia seperti buaya, dengan muncung besar di mukanya, berdiri di atas dua kaki, dengan ekor besar terjulur dari pinggang bawahnya, dari bawah baju besar yang labuh hingga ke lututnya. Makhluk itu berkumur, atau merengus sambil memegang ekornya kesakitan. Selain baju ringkas itu, makhluk ini juga memakai topi dengan nama Fico tertulis di sisinya, serta sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti rantai di lehernya, memegang sebuah buku dengan poket kulit di mana sebatang arang terjulur keluar.

b86880ca0c1c.en: “Absofuckinlutely. Wanna bet a beer there’s gonna be at least two rounds?” Itagiba’s chuckles turned serious, ready to throw down a fight of his own.
b86880ca0c1c.t: “Memang celaka pasti. Nak bertaruh sebiji bir yang akan ada sekurang-kurangnya dua pusingan?” Ketawa kecil Itagiba bertukar serius, bersedia untuk bertarung sendiri.

b91cb61bdbf1.en: A loud gasp came from Harry, trying to breathe in, but a suffocating darkness prevented him from grabbing much air. Whaaaat?
b91cb61bdbf1.t: Satu tercungap kuat datang dari Harry, cuba menarik nafas, tetapi kegelapan yang menyesakkan menghalangnya daripada mendapat banyak udara. Apaaaa?

bce4b5bc2bb7.en: Chapter VI subchapter 4: Harry, looking relieved, with a red-haired girl leaning on his shoulder in a crowd.
bce4b5bc2bb7.t: Bab VI subbab 4: Harry, kelihatan lega, dengan seorang gadis berambut merah bersandar di bahunya di tengah orang ramai.

bd288dc08c89.en: Harry did as told, but his body was not pleased, or prepared for a live session of yoga. The joint of his knees cracked, and his legs felt like he was carrying a dead cow on his shoulders. At the same time a small rip could be heard—coincidentally coming from his behind. Somehow, he was able to get to the requested position.
bd288dc08c89.t: Harry menurut, tetapi tubuhnya tidak gembira, atau bersedia untuk sesi yoga secara langsung. Sendi lututnya berderak, dan kakinya terasa seperti dia memikul lembu mati di bahunya. Pada masa yang sama koyakan kecil boleh didengari—secara kebetulan datang dari bahagian belakangnya. Entah bagaimana, dia berjaya mencapai posisi yang diminta.

be8311bef236.en: “You said to me you wanted to do it! Now go do it! C’mon Sora!” Eiri hugged her, prying her from her back, towards her side, then walking her towards Harry. “Harry, can you extend your hands towards her?”
be8311bef236.t: “Kau yang cakap kat aku kau nak buat! Sekarang pergi buat! Ayuh Sora!” Eiri memeluknya, menariknya dari belakangnya ke sisinya, kemudian membawanya berjalan ke arah Harry. “Harry, boleh kau hulurkan tangan kau kat dia?”

bff0e138384d.en: A sudden sharp stabbing pain rocked through the back of his neck, penetrating deep, and releasing a cold concoction into his bloodstream. His heart immediately raced, then a surge of adrenaline rose from deep in his guts as the claustrophobia kicked in. “ARGH!” Harry screamed into the pillow, trying to move his hand, but it did not result in much. Although he did find the slender, smooth skin of what appeared to be a foot, as soon as he touched what he thought was its sole, a mischievous female laugh ensued. In what appeared to be some sort of retribution, he felt an incredibly sharp nerve pain, coming from the girl further putting pressure on Harry’s pinned arms with what had to be her knees.
bff0e138384d.t: Satu kesakitan menikam yang tajam secara tiba-tiba menggegarkan belakang lehernya, menembusi jauh ke dalam, dan melepaskan campuran sejuk ke dalam aliran darahnya. Jantungnya serta-merta berlumba, kemudian lonjakan adrenalina naik dari dalam perutnya ketika klaustrofobia menyerang. “ARGH!” Harry menjerit ke dalam bantal, cuba menggerakkan tangannya, tetapi tidak banyak hasilnya. Walaupun dia memang terjumpa kulit ramping dan licin yang kelihatan seperti sebelah kaki, sebaik sahaja dia menyentuh apa yang disangkanya tapak kaki itu, ketawa nakal seorang perempuan menyusul. Dalam sesuatu yang kelihatan seperti sejenis balasan, dia merasakan sakit saraf yang amat tajam, datang dari gadis itu yang terus menekan lengan Harry yang tersepit dengan sesuatu yang pasti lututnya.

c09c98182313.en: “Move your badge up, you dipshit!” Maiara, speaking through her grinning teeth, looked ready to perform an impromptu teeth removal surgery with her fist.
c09c98182313.t: “Angkat lencana kau, bodoh sial!” Maiara, bercakap melalui giginya yang menyeringai, kelihatan bersedia untuk melakukan pembedahan mencabut gigi secara spontan dengan penumbuknya.

c0bd8fdfc329.en: Harry, with teary eyes, dry heaved for one last time. Spitting thick saliva in the sink, he then let out a groan as he let his neck relax. “I—dunno—I’m sorry.”
c0bd8fdfc329.t: Harry, dengan mata berair, termuntah kering buat kali terakhir. Meludahkan air liur pekat ke dalam sinki, dia kemudian mengerang sambil membiarkan lehernya mengendur. “Sa—saya tak tahu—maaf.”

c32f69058f65.en: “What the fuck? He’s done—” Maiara pointed her bloodied hammer towards Harry standing up, but still leaning heavily on the alligator humanoid.
c32f69058f65.t: “Apa benda celaka ni? Dia dah tamat—” Maiara menghalakan tukulnya yang berdarah ke arah Harry yang berdiri, tetapi masih bersandar berat pada makhluk berupa buaya itu.

c3f07dd9a1f4.en: “Sweet. Let’s get this show on the road. Harry, go back to the middle.” Itagiba shooed Harry towards where Maiara stood by herself, then he raised his thumb to nearby guards.
c3f07dd9a1f4.t: “Mantap. Jom kita mulakan pertunjukan. Harry, pergi balik ke tengah.” Itagiba menghalau Harry ke arah tempat Maiara berdiri seorang diri, kemudian dia mengangkat ibu jarinya kepada pengawal berdekatan.

c441ed5380cb.en: Doing as told, Harry struggled with buttoning his shirt again. That was until he pictured Eiri slapping his gut. Taking a deep breath, he pulled in his enlarged stomach with all his might, straining his face, and successfully buttoning his shirt in a swift move. Angering the water spirits by daring to open the water valve atop the sink, he then cleaned his face, and refreshed his hair—although an actual bath was definitely in order as he smelled sweaty, and his armpits were developing their own signature stench. Going back to the bedroom, he slipped on his shoes, then followed Kibe after he left him behind.
c441ed5380cb.t: Menurut, Harry bergelut mengancing kemejanya lagi. Sehinggalah dia membayangkan Eiri menampar perutnya. Menarik nafas dalam, dia mengempiskan perutnya yang membesar dengan sepenuh tenaga, menegangkan wajahnya, dan berjaya mengancing kemejanya dengan satu gerakan pantas. Menimbulkan kemarahan semangat air dengan berani membuka injap air di atas sinki, dia kemudian membersihkan mukanya, dan menyegarkan rambutnya—walaupun mandi yang sebenar memang perlu kerana dia berbau peluh, dan ketiaknya mula membentuk bau khasnya sendiri. Kembali ke bilik tidur, dia menyarung kasutnya, kemudian mengikut Kibe selepas dia ditinggalkan.

c792ca60a442.en: Noticing Harry being silent, Neferteri continued speaking with the same elegance, and confidence as a president's speech, while also sounding just as canned, and heavily rehearsed too, “Harry came from the Sanbi slums, and due to an unfortunate accident, he lost all his memories. Princess Maiara saw beauty in him, while we, Sanbi royals, saw an opportunity for him to become something bigger than himself. However, nothing in this world is for free—”
c792ca60a442.t: Perasan Harry diam, Neferteri terus bercakap dengan keanggunan dan keyakinan yang sama seperti ucapan seorang presiden, sambil turut kedengaran sama terhafal, dan sangat terlatih juga, “Harry berasal dari kawasan setinggan Sanbi, dan akibat kemalangan yang malang, dia kehilangan semua ingatannya. Puteri Maiara melihat keindahan dalam dirinya, manakala kami, Sanbi royal, melihat peluang untuk dia menjadi sesuatu yang lebih besar daripada dirinya. Namun, tiada apa di dunia ini yang percuma—”

c7c056369f60.en: Meanwhile, Neferteri walked by nearby, and started to handle the hourglass-like artifact, flipping switches, and shaking it to make some of the sand disappear behind a trapdoor on the side.
c7c056369f60.t: Sementara itu, Neferteri berjalan berdekatan, dan mula mengendalikan artifak seperti jam pasir itu, memetik suis, dan menggoncangnya untuk membuatkan sebahagian pasir hilang di sebalik pintu perangkap di sisi.

c9f123557205.en: Suddenly, a vision of what appeared to be a distant, murky dream came to him. He saw himself gasping for air, unable to move, fearing something humanoid in shape taking the life out of his eyes. Gasping for air, cold sweats bubbled up on Harry’s forehead. He then felt an off-balance sensation, as if he was on a small boat in the ocean being thrown around in a seesaw motion. He felt this sensation within him explode, as if he was in extreme danger, and he had to do something right that instant—but who knew what. He dry heaved on the sink, holding himself to it as if his life depended on it, while his heart pounded hard as if was running away from someone holding a bloodied knife. Whatever this sudden sensation was, it started to disappear as fast as it spiked up.
c9f123557205.t: Tiba-tiba, satu bayangan yang kelihatan seperti mimpi jauh yang kelam datang kepadanya. Dia melihat dirinya tercungap mencari udara, tidak dapat bergerak, takut akan sesuatu berbentuk manusia yang meragut nyawa dari matanya. Tercungap mencari udara, peluh sejuk merecik di dahi Harry. Dia kemudian merasakan sensasi tidak seimbang, seolah-olah dia berada di atas perahu kecil di lautan yang dilambung-lambung dalam gerakan jongkang-jongket. Dia merasakan sensasi ini dalam dirinya meletup, seolah-olah dia dalam bahaya yang amat sangat, dan dia perlu melakukan sesuatu pada saat itu juga—tetapi siapa tahu apa. Dia termuntah kering di sinki, berpaut padanya seolah-olah nyawanya bergantung padanya, sementara jantungnya berdegup kencang seolah-olah dia melarikan diri dari seseorang yang memegang pisau berdarah. Apa pun sensasi tiba-tiba ini, ia mula hilang secepat ia memuncak.

ca59e9496c1f.en: Harry felt nothing, but as the seconds passed, the hum of a tinnitus began rising, and rising, until it was deafening loudly. The roar of the crowds was next, then the feeling of something coarse that Harry was resting against. His vision came next, but his left eye was blurry, and reddened. The first thing he saw was an alligator in the shape of a humanoid, but with a large hat partly covering his hair with the name Honito written on the side.
ca59e9496c1f.t: Harry tidak merasakan apa-apa, tetapi ketika detik berlalu, dengung tinnitus mula meningkat, dan meningkat, sehingga ia memekakkan telinga. Ngauman orang ramai menyusul, kemudian perasaan sesuatu yang kasar tempat Harry bersandar. Penglihatannya datang seterusnya, tetapi mata kirinya kabur, dan merah. Perkara pertama yang dia nampak ialah seekor buaya berbentuk manusia, tetapi dengan topi besar yang menutup sebahagian rambutnya dengan nama Honito tertulis di sisinya.

caef10ba9be1.en: Looking around the bathroom, Harry looked around for something to wear, but there was nothing. “Can you pick it up for me, please?”
caef10ba9be1.t: Memandang sekeliling bilik mandi, Harry mencari sesuatu untuk dipakai, tetapi tiada apa-apa. “Boleh awak tolong ambilkan, tolong?”

cb53cfad02e9.en: Kibe let out a groan, and bent to the side to hear what she had to say. Kibe loudly murmured, “Hm-hm—oh?—huh?—I see—okay. Got it!” before standing up, and half-heartedly raising the contract. “Harry only has Fake Eye right now, but Sora tasted a bunch of what appears to be hardcore stuff that was injected in him beforehand. They do not appear to be active at the moment—Maiara?”
cb53cfad02e9.t: Kibe mengerang, dan membongkok ke sisi untuk mendengar apa yang hendak dikatakannya. Kibe bergumam dengan kuat, “Hm-hm—oh?—hah?—begitu—okey. Faham!” sebelum berdiri, dan mengangkat kontrak itu dengan separuh hati. “Harry cuma ada Fake Eye sekarang, tapi Sora dapat rasa banyak benda yang nampak macam bahan berat yang disuntik ke dalam dia sebelum ni. Benda-benda tu nampaknya tak aktif buat masa ni—Maiara?”

cc833afea7af.en: “I bet ten pearls it’s a fake body.” A woman in pink retorted. “No way that’s what Maiara likes. Have you seen Yacamin’s husband?”
cc833afea7af.t: “Aku bertaruh sepuluh Pearl tu fake body.” Seorang wanita berbaju merah jambu membalas. “Mustahil itu yang Maiara suka. Kau dah tengok suami Yacamin?”

cca0d699e393.en: The crowd grew quieter, seeing Maiara putting herself at a good distance from Harry, then adjusting herself and her weapon. With a sudden burst, she took off after Harry, grunting loudly.
cca0d699e393.t: Orang ramai menjadi lebih senyap, melihat Maiara meletakkan dirinya pada jarak yang jauh dari Harry, kemudian membetulkan dirinya dan senjatanya. Dengan ledakan tiba-tiba, dia meluru ke arah Harry, merengus kuat.

ccfeb30bbc8c.en: Harry felt time slow down. He could see her pace growing faster and faster. He could feel her hammer rushing in the wind. His right hand, holding the short sword, immediately dropped it, and rushed to help his desperate left hand, trying to prop his shield as hard as he could, assuming that’s where the hammer was gonna land. On her last steps flying towards him, he could even see her uvula, and the small pupils of her eyes. Harry last saw her long ponytail, violently swinging the wind, just before the weapon made a loud bang on the shield.
ccfeb30bbc8c.t: Harry merasakan masa menjadi perlahan. Dia dapat melihat langkahnya semakin laju dan laju. Dia dapat merasakan tukulnya membelah angin. Tangan kanannya, yang memegang pedang pendek, serta-merta menjatuhkannya, dan bergegas membantu tangan kirinya yang terdesak, cuba menegakkan perisainya sekuat mungkin, dengan andaian di situlah tukul itu akan mendarat. Pada langkah terakhirnya yang terbang ke arahnya, dia malah dapat melihat anak tekaknya, dan anak mata kecilnya. Harry kali terakhir melihat ekor kudanya yang panjang, menghayun angin dengan ganas, sebelum senjata itu berdentum kuat pada perisai.

ce7bc0e1ae34.en: Harry did so, and held the badge with his hands as if it was a good luck charm.
ce7bc0e1ae34.t: Harry menurut, dan memegang lencana itu dengan tangannya seolah-olah ia tangkal tuah.

cf28b6bfabec.en: “That’s okay. Let’s go tell Kibe what you found.” Eiri walked Sora towards Kibe, holding her tightly from the side, seeming to give a bit of comfort from the sea of eyes looking at them.
cf28b6bfabec.t: “Tak apa. Jom kita bagi tahu Kibe apa yang kau jumpa.” Eiri membawa Sora berjalan ke arah Kibe, memeluknya erat dari sisi, nampaknya memberikan sedikit keselesaan dari lautan mata yang memandang mereka.

cf66e8d52726.en: Harry looked back at Kibe, and saw him shift his gaze away from him, then walk towards the door. Looking down at his pelvis, he instead saw his hairy belly blocking most of his exposed down-under companion from his eyes. “Oh! Sorry!” Harry’s eyes startled, and he looked like he was electrocuted, quickly jumping towards the bathroom, and closing the door.
cf66e8d52726.t: Harry memandang semula Kibe, dan melihatnya mengalihkan pandangan darinya, kemudian berjalan ke arah pintu. Memandang ke bawah ke pelvisnya, sebaliknya dia nampak perutnya yang berbulu menghalang sebahagian besar teman bawahnya yang terdedah dari pandangannya. “Oh! Maaf!” Mata Harry terkejut, dan dia kelihatan seperti terkena renjatan elektrik, cepat-cepat melompat ke bilik mandi, dan menutup pintu.

d422abc6bc27.en: Itagiba caught everyone's attention when he struck the hourglass-like artifact onto the table “ALL RIGHT, MY PEEPS! PLACE YOUR BETS! WET YOUR LIPS! AND GET READY TO CELEBRATE! YOU GOT A SMALL TIMEHUNK BEFORE THE DUEL STARTS!”
d422abc6bc27.t: Itagiba menarik perhatian semua orang apabila dia menghentak artifak seperti jam pasir itu ke atas meja “OKEY, GENG AKU! BUAT TARUHAN KAMU! BASAHKAN BIBIR KAMU! DAN BERSEDIA UNTUK BERPESTA! KAMU ADA SATU TIMEHUNK KECIL SEBELUM PERTARUNGAN BERMULA!”

d650b50f8576.en: A hand slammed Harry’s head into the pillow, muffling his screams. “Shut the fuck up!” A cold sounding girly voice oozed with anger.
d650b50f8576.t: Satu tangan menghentak kepala Harry ke dalam bantal, meredam jeritannya. “Diamlah, celaka!” Suara gadis yang kedengaran dingin meleleh dengan kemarahan.

dd6327cda8cd.en: “Yes—my apologies, Princess Maiara. I will be as fast as I can.” Sora’s reddened face drew straight, paying attention as she started to sniff stuff like a dog. Crouching down, she smelled her feet, then up her legs, hovering near her privates, then finishing up by smelling her stomach, and lower back. “Please—princess Maiara—close your eyes and—”
dd6327cda8cd.t: “Baik—maafkan saya, Puteri Maiara. Saya akan secepat yang boleh.” Wajah Sora yang merah menjadi serius, memberi perhatian ketika dia mula menghidu benda seperti anjing. Mencangkung, dia menghidu kaki Maiara, kemudian naik ke betisnya, berlegar berhampiran kemaluannya, kemudian selesai dengan menghidu perutnya, dan pinggang bawahnya. “Tolong—puteri Maiara—pejamkan mata dan—”

ddff84a43ee0.en: Being among people is one thing, but being surrounded by them is an entirely different thing. At least that’s what Harry’s anxiety told him as he felt something stuck in his throat now that everyone’s eyes were really on him. His hands tried to hide themselves away in the pocket of his pants, but there were no pockets, so they just fumbled around, having no idea what to do—nearly dropping his badge in the process.
ddff84a43ee0.t: Berada di kalangan orang ramai ialah satu perkara, tetapi dikelilingi mereka ialah perkara yang sama sekali berbeza. Sekurang-kurangnya itulah yang dikatakan keresahan Harry kepadanya ketika dia merasakan sesuatu tersekat di kerongkongnya kerana kini mata semua orang benar-benar tertumpu padanya. Tangannya cuba menyembunyikan diri dalam poket seluarnya, tetapi tiada poket, jadi ia hanya meraba-raba, tidak tahu apa yang hendak dilakukan—hampir menjatuhkan lencananya dalam proses itu.

e2fa9bbf1c61.en: Kibe looked towards Sanbi royals. The already kinda silent festival grew pretty dead; everyone focused their attention on Neferteri.
e2fa9bbf1c61.t: Kibe memandang ke arah Sanbi royal. Pesta yang sudah agak senyap itu menjadi sunyi sepi; semua orang menumpukan perhatian kepada Neferteri.

e3129db6957e.en: That was until he suddenly gasped, waking up in the bathtub, sitting forward, while Sora was carefully brushing his back. Harry wanted to look at her, but it felt like he couldn’t—her tantalizing petite naked body was calling out for him, but he just couldn’t bring himself to actually do it. He wanted to know more, but at the same time he didn’t want her to stop caressing his back. Plus, the warmth of the bathtub was simply too great. Hugging his knees, Harry let out a deep breath, looking at the bubbly water slowly waving around, having a rather calming effect. His mind was devoid of thought, just appreciating the serenity of that moment.
e3129db6957e.t: Sehinggalah dia tiba-tiba tercungap, tersedar dalam tab mandi, duduk ke depan, sementara Sora dengan berhati-hati menggosok belakangnya. Harry mahu memandangnya, tetapi rasanya dia tidak boleh—tubuh kecilnya yang bogel dan menggoda memanggilnya, tetapi dia tidak sanggup benar-benar melakukannya. Dia mahu tahu lebih lanjut, tetapi pada masa yang sama dia tidak mahu Sora berhenti membelai belakangnya. Tambahan pula, kehangatan tab mandi itu terlalu nikmat. Memeluk lututnya, Harry menghembus nafas dalam, memandang air berbuih yang perlahan-lahan beralun, memberikan kesan yang agak menenangkan. Fikirannya kosong tanpa fikiran, hanya menghargai ketenangan saat itu.

e5a10089f5f9.en: Harry no longer had the strength to even move his head away from the pillow to draw fresh air. Instead, he kept gasping, feeling the impending doom of the encroaching darkness knocking at his door. Help! Harry tried to scream again, but only his mind murmured the words, while his mouth just let out a gargle. He pictured himself on the warmth of Eiri’s shoulder again as his eyes grew teary. His entire body now merged with the bed; he could not feel where things started, or ended—in a way he had become one with the universe.
e5a10089f5f9.t: Harry tidak lagi mempunyai kekuatan walaupun untuk menggerakkan kepalanya dari bantal untuk menghirup udara segar. Sebaliknya, dia terus tercungap-cungap, merasakan malapetaka kegelapan yang semakin hampir mengetuk pintunya. Tolong! Harry cuba menjerit lagi, tetapi hanya fikirannya yang membisikkan kata-kata itu, sementara mulutnya hanya mengeluarkan bunyi berkumur. Dia membayangkan dirinya di atas bahu Eiri yang hangat sekali lagi ketika matanya berkaca. Seluruh tubuhnya kini bercantum dengan katil; dia tidak dapat merasakan di mana sesuatu bermula, atau berakhir—dalam satu cara dia telah menjadi satu dengan alam semesta.

e5e55c006fc5.en: “Ow? That’s easy. Maiara is confident in her hammer, but she is wide open when it comes to defense. Just stab her again to slow her down as both of you can’t heal between turns.” Itagiba looked at Harry’s weapons. “Just pour your heart into it, and you’re gonna be fine. Remember, we’re all here to have fun.”
e5e55c006fc5.t: “Eh? Senang je. Maiara yakin dengan tukul dia, tapi dia terdedah habis bila bertahan. Tikam je dia lagi untuk lambatkan dia sebab korang berdua tak boleh sembuh antara giliran.” Itagiba memandang senjata Harry. “Curahkan je sepenuh hati kau, dan kau akan okey. Ingat, kita semua kat sini nak berseronok.”

e6ca0d633f5b.en: Itagiba whispered towards Harry’s ear, “We’re here to throw a party, don’t be negative or you will ruin the mood.” He looked at Harry with fervor in his eyes, silently waiting for Harry to confirm.
e6ca0d633f5b.t: Itagiba berbisik ke telinga Harry, “Kita kat sini nak berpesta, jangan negatif nanti kau rosakkan mood.” Dia memandang Harry dengan semangat berkobar di matanya, menunggu dalam diam Harry mengesahkan.

e94dc8104327.en: Itagiba picked up a large, colored dice. His hands, holding the weight of the metal construct, pointed it towards Maiara.
e94dc8104327.t: Itagiba mengambil sebiji dadu besar berwarna-warni. Tangannya, menampung berat binaan logam itu, menghalakannya ke arah Maiara.

e97f4edd1b8a.en: Kibe continued, now pointing the contract towards Sora, already reddened in the face, involuntarily holding her skirt—nearly tearing the stitches apart by sheer embarrassment, looking like she knew her fate. “Sora Sanbi Blue-Grass is gonna do the check.”
e97f4edd1b8a.t: Kibe menyambung, kini menghalakan kontrak itu ke arah Sora, yang sudah merah padam, tanpa sengaja memegang skirtnya—hampir mengoyakkan jahitan kerana malu yang amat, kelihatan seperti dia tahu nasibnya. “Sora Sanbi Blue-Grass akan buat pemeriksaan.”

ea9c7ef485e3.en: Harry’s voice sounded like his throat was bone dry. “Red—and yellow?”
ea9c7ef485e3.t: Suara Harry kedengaran seperti kerongkongnya kering kontang. “Merah—dan kuning?”

eaab9d164f68.en: “My daughter! Show him what you are made of!” Itagiba let out a wide smile, grabbing another beer bottle from a Sanbi maid.
eaab9d164f68.t: “Anak aku! Tunjuk kat dia siapa kau!” Itagiba tersenyum lebar, mengambil sebotol lagi bir dari seorang pembantu rumah Sanbi.

ec7085f4055a.en: Itagiba showed the dice towards Harry, but this time he moved the dice around, giving him the opportunity to see all the color possibilities: blue, red, yellow, green, black, and white.
ec7085f4055a.t: Itagiba menunjukkan dadu itu kepada Harry, tetapi kali ini dia menggerakkan dadu itu, memberinya peluang untuk melihat semua kemungkinan warna: biru, merah, kuning, hijau, hitam dan putih.

ed4507719dd6.en: Harry looked at Maiara in the background, also glancing towards him with a large tribal-like hammer in hand. A chilling sensation went down his spine, feeling the theoretical weight of it coming down at him.
ed4507719dd6.t: Harry memandang Maiara di latar belakang, yang turut mengerling ke arahnya dengan tukul besar seperti tukul puak di tangan. Sensasi dingin mengalir di tulang belakangnya, merasakan berat teorinya menghentamnya.

ed6029323f26.en: Itagiba, meanwhile, picked up an artifact that looked like an hourglass, but had a thicker wooden structure around it, with three switches on the side. He played with them, then shook the artifact around.
ed6029323f26.t: Itagiba, sementara itu, mengambil sebuah artifak yang kelihatan seperti jam pasir, tetapi mempunyai struktur kayu yang lebih tebal di sekelilingnya, dengan tiga suis di sisi. Dia bermain-main dengannya, kemudian menggoncang artifak itu.

f12d0efc199e.en: Where did I put it? Harry glanced around the bedroom, but could not find his clothes—at least until he walked past the bed, and found them, on a pile in the ground close to where Kibe was standing. Grabbing them, and making his way back to the bathroom, Harry quickly put on his black underwear, pants, and socks only to realize that he was smelling something different all this time. It was like sweat, but also faintly sweet. He looked at himself in the large mirror hanging on the door. It was still him, but now he started to feel more like him—rather than expecting an even fatter man wearing glasses. Focusing on his face, he did not see anything, even though he for sure could feel this slightly dried slimy feeling. He touched it, took a whiff, and ended up tasting it too. What is this?—hmm—it’s not bad.
f12d0efc199e.t: Mana aku letak? Harry mengerling sekeliling bilik tidur, tetapi tidak dapat menemui pakaiannya—sekurang-kurangnya sehingga dia berjalan melepasi katil, dan menemuinya, bertimbun di lantai berhampiran tempat Kibe berdiri. Mengambilnya, dan kembali ke bilik mandi, Harry cepat-cepat memakai seluar dalam hitam, seluar, dan stokinnya hanya untuk menyedari bahawa dia telah menghidu sesuatu yang berbeza selama ini. Ia seperti peluh, tetapi juga sedikit manis. Dia memandang dirinya dalam cermin besar yang tergantung di pintu. Ia masih dirinya, tetapi kini dia mula merasa lebih seperti dirinya—bukannya menjangkakan lelaki yang lebih gemuk memakai cermin mata. Menumpukan perhatian pada wajahnya, dia tidak nampak apa-apa, walaupun dia pasti dapat merasakan rasa berlendir yang sedikit kering ini. Dia menyentuhnya, menghidunya, dan akhirnya merasanya juga. Apa benda ni?—hmm—tak teruk pun.

f39eaab3ff3b.en: Before the stranger knew it, everything became black—
f39eaab3ff3b.t: Sebelum orang asing itu sedar, segala-galanya menjadi hitam—

f5f22c993f96.en: The lively crowd quieted down, all paying attention to the Sanbi Royals standing right in front of the Sanbi statue fountain.
f5f22c993f96.t: Orang ramai yang meriah itu menjadi senyap, semuanya memberi perhatian kepada Sanbi Royal yang berdiri betul-betul di hadapan air pancut patung Sanbi.

f6be2611d54a.en: Chapter VI subchapter 2: the silver-haired man holds a vial over Harry, who lies shirtless on a bed.
f6be2611d54a.t: Bab VI subbab 2: lelaki berambut perak memegang botol kecil di atas Harry, yang terbaring tanpa baju di atas katil.

fb06db46807d.en: With tears still streaming down his face, Harry heard the energy of the crowd penetrate his eyes and ears. He looked towards Eiri and saw Sora still hiding away in her back, but Eiri herself was looking back at him, cleaning away tears as her saddened lips held back much to say.
fb06db46807d.t: Dengan air mata masih mengalir di wajahnya, Harry mendengar tenaga orang ramai menembusi mata dan telinganya. Dia memandang ke arah Eiri dan nampak Sora masih bersembunyi di belakangnya, tetapi Eiri sendiri memandang balik kepadanya, mengesat air mata sementara bibirnya yang sedih menahan banyak perkara untuk dikatakan.

fb2745665f00.en: Stab her in the belly? Harry brought the shortsword to a closer view, and looked at Maiara’s belly as she walked back towards where she previously stood up. Harry’s breath grew shallow, and his skin pale. His hands went next, beginning to tremble as he rehearsed the defense in his mind, until something clicked. “Attack! What about attacking?”
fb2745665f00.t: Tikam perut dia? Harry mendekatkan pedang pendek itu untuk dilihat, dan memandang perut Maiara ketika dia berjalan kembali ke tempat dia berdiri tadi. Nafas Harry menjadi cetek, dan kulitnya pucat. Tangannya menyusul, mula menggeletar ketika dia melatih pertahanan itu dalam fikirannya, sehingga sesuatu terlintas. “Serang! Macam mana dengan menyerang?”

fc79ca4b84ab.en: “It’s fine! Right, my people?” Itagiba raised his beer bottle.
fc79ca4b84ab.t: “Tak apa! Kan, rakyat aku?” Itagiba mengangkat botol birnya.

fe0ceef3170e.en: Nodding, Harry made a motion to sit up in bed. A groan came out of him, feeling sore, as if he had just ran a marathon. His neck felt funny too, from maybe sleeping wrongly, but it was also quite tender—like he tried to show off by deadlifting far more than what he could. He stood up and lay his feet on the cold floor, finally feeling them as if they were not there just now. Standing up, his thighs, and back were slightly out of balance, and he felt some sort of vertigo kick in, which somehow disappeared as he started to get his blood moving, slowly walking towards the bathroom.
fe0ceef3170e.t: Mengangguk, Harry membuat gerakan untuk duduk di atas katil. Satu erangan keluar daripadanya, merasa sengal, seolah-olah dia baru berlari maraton. Lehernya terasa pelik juga, mungkin kerana tidur dalam posisi salah, tetapi ia juga agak lembut sakitnya—seperti dia cuba menunjuk-nunjuk dengan mengangkat berat jauh lebih daripada yang mampu. Dia berdiri dan meletakkan kakinya di lantai yang sejuk, akhirnya merasakannya seolah-olah ia tiada di situ tadi. Berdiri, peha dan belakangnya sedikit tidak seimbang, dan dia merasakan sejenis pening menyerang, yang entah bagaimana hilang ketika darahnya mula bergerak, perlahan-lahan berjalan ke arah bilik mandi.

ffb150e85a09.en: The crowd cheered back. “Go Harry! Go Harry! Go Harry!”
ffb150e85a09.t: Orang ramai bersorak balas. “Ayuh Harry! Ayuh Harry! Ayuh Harry!”
